eval|shop|job work says sku not in maste.text: This is on Master Database , not on this screen. Factory screens keep the master database for up to half an hour, so a SKU added just now may not be in their lists yet; press Refresh on Master Database (or reload the page) and open the screen again. What it's for Factory screens keep their own copy of the master so they open fast. A SKU added a minute ago may not be in that copy yet. How it works The copy is re-read only every half hour in the background. Press Refresh on Master Database (or reload the page) to read the master at once, then open the screen again. Some entry forms also look a typed SKU up in the master itself, so a new SKU may be accepted there even before the refresh. The SKU itself is saved in the master as soon as you add it; only the copy on other screens lags. When to use it When a SKU you just added is not found in Job Work, Cutting or another list. Why The master is large and changes rarely, so it is read again only every 30 minutes in the background. Where a SKU is typed and checked (for example moving a Job Work row onto a new SKU), the app asks the database for that one SKU itself.

eval|shop|आज टेबल पर 200 पीस कटे, कहाँ ल.text: यह Cutting Data पर है, इस स्क्रीन पर नहीं। Cutting Data कटिंग रजिस्टर है: किसी SKU के कितने पीस कटे, किस ऑर्डर के लिए, किस कपड़े से, और कितना कपड़ा लगा और बर्बाद हुआ। नई एंट्री के लिए + New cutting entry दबाएँ। यह किस लिए है यह कटिंग का फ़ैक्टरी रिकॉर्ड है: कारीगरों को जाने से पहले यह साबित करता है कि हर ऑर्डर के कौन से पीस बने हैं। यह कैसे काम करता है हर पंक्ति एक कटिंग है: तारीख, ऑर्डर, SKU, कपड़ा, पीस, इश्यू हुई या नहीं, और लगा व बर्बाद कपड़ा। टेबल के ऊपर के कार्ड कुल कटे पीस, कारीगरों को इश्यू, इश्यू बाकी, SKU, ऑर्डर और वेस्ट जोड़ते हैं। नई एंट्री से उस SKU और ऑर्डर के लिए Job Work Register जितने पीस इश्यू कर सकता है वह बढ़ता है। कटिंग यहाँ दर्ज होती है; जाँच Quality Control में और कारीगरों को इश्यू Job Work Register में। कब इस्तेमाल करें जब भी कटिंग हो, और जब देखना हो कि किसी ऑर्डर की कितनी कटिंग हुई। क्यों कारीगर को इश्यू की सीमा इन्हीं आंकड़ों से है, इसलिए बिना कटे पीस इश्यू नहीं हो सकते (जब तक PPC ने लाइन सीधे Job Work को न भेजी हो)।

eval|shop|waste % showing red in cutting.text: This is on Cutting Data , not on this screen. Waste above 10% of the fabric used shows in red. A dash (—) means nobody measured the cloth for that entry, and Entries measured tells how many entries have a figure. What it's for Gives a quick view of how much cloth is being lost on the cuts shown, and how many entries have a real figure behind them. How it works The cards above the table add up only the entries shown after your filters. Waste (m) carries the waste per cent, waste divided by fabric used; above 10% it turns red. In the table, a row's Waste % also turns red above 10%. A dash (—) means that entry has no figure, so it is not counted as zero. Entries measured reads like 12 / 20: entries with a fabric-used figure out of all shown. When to use it When reviewing how well the cutting table uses cloth.

eval|shop|need a day wise qc summary.text: This is on Quality Control , not on this screen. Choose QC ledger (day-wise) . One row a day shows what came back from karigars, QC pass, sent to spotting and touching, back from them, for alteration and rejected. It shows the last 30 days unless you set the Dated boxes. What it's for A day-by-day record of what QC did, so the owner can see how much was checked on any day. How it works Pick QC ledger (day-wise) ; each row is one day, newest first. Columns count what came back from karigars, QC pass, pieces to spotting and touching, those back from them, rejected after them, and For alteration and Rejected at QC. All passed = QC pass + back from spotting and touching. A TOTAL row sits at the bottom. Without dates it shows the last 30 days; set the From and To dates for another window. When to use it At the end of the day, or when checking how the QC table is keeping up. Why "All passed" = QC pass + back from spotting and touching.

eval|shop|what are the options in how it.text: This is on Production flow , not on this screen. In the PPC form, How it is made sets the route: Printing, Printing + Embroidery, Cutting (no printing), Job Work (no printing, no cutting — straight to karigars) or Outsourced (made outside, received finished). What it's for Not every product goes through every step. The route tells the flow which steps to skip. How it works How it is made in the PPC form offers: Printing, Printing + Embroidery, Cutting, Job Work, Outsourced. Printing + Embroidery also asks Embroidery by : our own department or an embroidery vendor. When to use it Every time you plan a line, before pressing Raise the plan. eval|shop|make a packing list from a box.text: This is on Packing List , not on this screen. eval|shop|अमेज़न की बॉक्स कंटेंट फाइल कै.text: यह Packing List पर है, इस स्क्रीन पर नहीं। सेव की गई लिस्ट पर FBA file दबाएँ और Amazon से डाउनलोड किया box-content टेम्पलेट (.xlsx) चुनें; वह मात्रा, वज़न और साइज़ भरकर वापस आता है। यह किस लिए है Amazon हर शिपमेंट के लिए box-content शीट देता है। यह उसे सेव लिस्ट से भर देता है, इसलिए मात्रा, वज़न और साइज़ दोबारा टाइप नहीं होते। यह कैसे काम करता है FBA file Amazon की template (.xlsx) चुनने को कहता है; उसमें "Box packing information" नाम की शीट होनी चाहिए। हर बॉक्स को कॉलम M से अपना कॉलम मिलता है। SKU की पंक्ति और बॉक्स के मिलन पर मात्रा जाती है; वज़न और साइज़ अपनी पंक्तियों में। किलो पाउंड में और सेंटीमीटर इंच में बदलकर लिखे जाते हैं। भरी फ़ाइल Amazon-FBA-title-date.xlsx नाम से डाउनलोड होती है। संदेश बताता है कितने खाने भरे और कौन-सा SKU template में नहीं था। बिना बॉक्स वाली लिस्ट पर "That list has no boxes in it yet" आता है। कब इस्तेमाल करें Amazon में शिपमेंट बनने और उसकी box template डाउनलोड करने के बाद। क्यों वज़न और साइज़ Amazon के लिए पाउंड और इंच में बदले जाते हैं। लिस्ट में बॉक्स नहीं बताए तो पहले बॉक्स जोड़ें या स्कैन करें।

eval|shop|what does runs out in mean.text: This is on Replenishment , not on this screen. The Runs out in buttons group SKUs by how soon FBA stock runs out: Out · sold in 90d is empty and losing sales now, Out · no sale 90d is empty but not selling, then 1–15 d up to 60 d+ . What it's for The row of buttons answers: how soon does each SKU run out? It lets you start with the urgent ones. How it works Each button shows its count: All , Out · sold in 90d , Out · no sale 90d , 1–15 d , 16–30 d , 31–45 d , 46–60 d , 60 d+ . Empty SKUs go to the two Out buttons; the rest go by Cover (d) . A SKU is in exactly one button. Press a button to see only those SKUs; press it again to switch it off. The counts are taken before the Need, Cat and other filters. eval|shop|how do i reject a vendor order.text: This is on Vendor Order Requests , not on this screen. Open Approve / reject , write the reason in the Note box, then press Reject ; a reason is required. What it's for Saying no with a reason lets the requester fix it instead of guessing. How it works Press Approve / reject on a waiting row. Write the reason in the note box ( Note (a reason is required to reject) ). Press Reject . With an empty note it is refused: "Say why it is rejected…". The request becomes Rejected, the reason is stored and shown in red on the row, and the vendor never sees it. When to use it When a request is too big, has the wrong vendor or lines, or the printer cap is exceeded. Why The person who raised it reads the reason and knows what to change before raising it again.

eval|shop|difference between short and r.text: This is on History — what printers have sent , not on this screen. Short means the pieces never arrived; Returned means they arrived but were rejected and sent back. Both stay owed by the printer. What it's for The two look alike but mean different things. Returned pieces were seen and refused; short pieces simply never came. How it works The printer recorded a number; you type Received — kept and Returned — sent back . What is left of the printer's number after both shows as short on the row. Only the kept figure is credited, so returned and short pieces stay owed and must be made again. When to use it While accepting a delivery that is not the full count the printer wrote. Why The printer is credited only with what you kept, so anything returned has to be made again.

eval|shop|har printer mahine me kitna ka.text: Ye Printer Allocation par hai, is screen par nahi. Mahine ki capacity = (tables × delivery record wale printers ka aam pieces per table per month) aur is printer ke apne best month me se jo bada ho. Type ki hui Capacity if there is nothing to measure yet tabhi lagti hai jab dono me se kuch naapa na ja sake. Yeh kis liye hai Batata hai ki printer ki capacity sirf type kiya figure kyun nahi hai: woh printers ki asal delivery se chalti hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Delivery record wale har printer ka best month uske tables se bhaag kiya jata hai; inka beech wala maan 'aam per table' hai. Capacity = tables × aam per table, ya printer ka apna best month agar zyada ho. Dono naape na ja sakein tabhi typed Capacity use hota hai. Jisne abhi tables badhaye hain uska per-table figure ek mahina chalne tak kam rehta hai, kyunki purane mahine aaj ke tables se bhaag kiye jaate hain. Kab use karein Jab sochein ki printer ki capacity kyun badli. Kyun Har printer ka best month (average nahi) uski tables se divide kiya jaata hai, aur printers me beech wala figure “aam” rate maana jaata hai, taaki ek achha mahina sabki capacity na badhaye. Chalu mahina 7 tareekh ke baad hi pure mahine ke hisab se badhaya jaata hai. Tables aaj ki gini jaati hain, isliye jisne abhi tables badhai uski capacity ek mahina chalne tak kam dikhegi. Kya karein Printer Allocation kholiye, Printers — capacity and load chuniye. Printer par Edit dabaiye: note me likha hai capacity kaise bani. Dekhiye Vendor (for the delivery history) sahi vendor hai.

eval|shop|can i delete an old sku from m.text: This is on Master Database , not on this screen. Only an admin can delete a SKU, with Delete in its Edit box; a SKU used in any record (Job Work, Cutting, Press, Order Book, QC) cannot be deleted. What it's for Deleting a SKU that live records point to would leave them describing a product that no longer exists, so it is guarded and limited to admins. How it works Press Edit on the SKU row; Delete appears in that box for an admin only. It asks you to confirm, naming the SKU, and says it cannot be undone. The SKU is counted in Job Work Register, Cutting, Press, Order Book and Quality Control; if any row uses it the delete is refused with the count per register, and those rows must be removed or moved first. The Edit box also shows, before you decide, how many live rows use the SKU. When to use it When a SKU was added by mistake and nothing has been made on it yet. Why The message names where it is used; those rows must be removed or moved to another SKU first. Only an admin can do this — please ask your admin.

eval|shop|asin dalte time error not an a.text: This is on Master Database , not on this screen. An ASIN is exactly ten letters and digits, like B0CHW5KTPB; check for spaces or missing characters. What it's for A wrong ASIN would link a SKU to the wrong listing and picture, so the master accepts only the exact Amazon format. How it works The check applies to both ASIN and Parent ASIN when you save a SKU or apply an Import. Exactly ten letters or digits are accepted, like B0CHW5KTPB; small letters are turned into capitals. A missing character, an extra one, or a dash or other symbol fails the check, and the message shows what was typed. A blank is allowed; ASIN from Amazon can fill it later. When to use it When a SKU or an Import row is refused with this message.

eval|shop|new colour launched, need to c.text: This is on Master Database , not on this screen. Pick the view SKU codes — a new colour’s SKUs , fill Brand , Colour and Colour code , then press Create the new SKUs . What it's for A new colour means the same SKUs again with a new colour code. This builds them all in one go, so nobody types hundreds of codes. How it works Pick the view SKU codes — a new colour's SKUs ; the table lists every article, subtype and size with its base code and the full code for the colour. Fill Brand , Colour (from the Colour master) and Colour code ; an existing colour brings its own code, and a code already used by another colour is refused. The In master column shows In master , New or the other colour that holds the code. Press Create the new SKUs , read the list, then confirm. Only SKUs not yet in the master are made; each copies its details from the same article, subtype and size in another colour, then the recipe fills what is blank (its Yes/No answers replace the copied ones). No picture is copied. When to use it When a new colour is launched across a range. Why Each article, subtype and size has a base code; the colour code is put into it (RTC-6060 + 327 = RTC327-6060). Only SKUs not already in the master are made; the rest is copied from another colour.

eval|shop|zip yes kiya to chain length m.text: This is on Master Database , not on this screen. When Zip, Ruffle, Piping dori or Filler fabric is Yes, fill its figure: zip size (chain length), ruffle metres, piping metres or the standard filling quantity. What it's for A Yes without its figure makes a SKU look complete while the factory cannot work out how many zips, how much ruffle cloth, piping cord or filling to issue. How it works If Zip is Yes, fill Zip size / chain length (in) ; Zips per piece may be left blank and then counts as one. If Ruffle is Yes, fill Ruffle fabric consumption (m) ; if the recipe for that product and size already has ruffle metres, that is accepted. If Piping dori is Yes, fill the dori metres; if Filler fabric is Yes, fill Standard filling qty . A SKU that is bought finished needs none of these. When to use it When saving a SKU, or an Import row, is refused with one of these messages. Why Ruffle metres can also come from the recipe for that product and size.

eval|shop|where do i put fabric width in.text: This is on Masters , not on this screen. In Masters pick Fabric type ; an admin types Width (inches) (1 to 200) and the Greige name (what the mill is sent) straight into the table, and it saves at once. What it's for The width turns pieces into square metres for cutting, the printers and RFD cloth, and the greige name is what a greige order to the mill is written under. How it works In Masters pick Fabric type . An admin types Width (inches) (1 to 200) and the Greige name (what the mill is sent) in the row. It saves the moment you leave the box; a message under the table confirms it. One greige name can belong to only one fabric, otherwise it is refused. A row with no width shows no width or from the name . When to use it When a new fabric is added, or a screen says a fabric has no width. Why Without a width the cloth cannot be measured in square metres; without a greige name the fabric cannot go on a greige PO. One greige name can belong to only one fabric. Only an admin can do this — please ask your admin.

parts|pmdb|+ New SKU button kya karta h.text: + New SKU — Master Database par button: Naya SKU (ya Fabric for printing mein fabric row) jodne ka form kholta hai; master database edit right chahiye. Yeh kis liye hai Catalogue mein product jodta hai taaki baaki app use use kar sake. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Sirf Change the Master Database right se dikhta hai; Fabric for printing view mein label + Fabric SKU ho jata hai. Form mein SKU, Article type, Article subtype, Colour aur Size, aur baaki jaankari maangta hai; khali boxes recipe se bhar jate hain, aur recipe ke Yes/No jawab form ke jawabon ki jagah le lete hain. Master mein pehle se maujood SKU refuse karta hai aur zip, ruffle, piping aur filling ke figures check karta hai. Kab use karein Jab koi naya product aaye.

parts|fgi|ye Re-order level kis kaam ka.text: Re-order level — Finished Goods par box: Is level ya usse kam par stock Low dikhta hai; khali ya 0 matlab koi level nahi. Yeh kis liye hai SKU ke liye ek nyoontam seema tay karta hai taaki khatam hone se pehle screen chetavani de. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Pieces ki sankhya likhiye; utne ya kam par SKU Low ginaa jata hai: woh status drop-down ke Low mein dikhta hai, aur table ke upar ki line use re-order level par ya usse neeche ginti hai. Khali ya 0 ka matlab koi level nahi. Kab use karein Jab kisi tez chalne wale SKU ki pehle se chetavani chahiye.

parts|ord|what happens if i press Days o.text: Days open — column on Order Console: Days since the line was opened in production. What it's for Shows how long the line has waited since it was opened in production. Old lines are the likely stuck ones. When to use it Use with the age drop-down to find lines to chase or close.

parts|pa|Cut किसलिए है.text: आपका सवाल एक से ज़्यादा जवाबों से मिलता है। आप कौन-सा पूछ रहे हैं? Cut क्या है · Production Analysis (note) Cut क्या है · Production Analysis (column) Cut क्या है · Order Console

parts|so|Open ka kya matlab hota hai.text: Open — Sales Orders par button: Order kholta hai: har SKU Qty, Cut, Made, Owed aur In order book ke saath, aur quantity ke badlaav. Yeh kis liye hai List chhode bina order ke har SKU aur uski pragati dekhne deta hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Order window khulti hai, har SKU ki ek row ke saath: Qty, Cut, Made, Owed, Delivery, Priority aur order book me hai ya nahi. Upar ka note kul sankhya, kisne approve kiya aur remarks batata hai. Neeche ki tables me approve ke baad hue quantity badlav aur B2B me details ke badlav dikhte hain. Approved order par admins aur Approve sales orders right wale logon ko har SKU par Change qty bhi milta hai. Kab use karein Jab koi poochhe ki order kahan tak pahuncha.

parts|cx|what does Raise an adjustment s.text: Raise an adjustment — button on Customer Orders: Marks the line Adjustment Raised — it is only put on record; nothing goes to the floor. What it's for Puts on record that this line must be made, when stock cannot cover it. How it works Inside the Decide box on an Open line, always available. Sets the status to Adjustment Raised and Where from to "raised, not yet on the floor". It only records the decision. No stock moves and no production order opens. When to use it When neither Amazon nor India has enough and the piece will have to be made.

parts|fgi|Order Console orders button ky.text: Order Console orders — Finished Goods par box: Is session me jin orders par pack hoga; ye ya Amazon shipment plan dijiye. Yeh kis liye hai Session ko batata hai ki pieces kin orders ke liye pack ho rahe hain, taaki galat article pakda ja sake. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Order Console ke order numbers commas se alag karke likhiye. Jo number Order Console mein nahi hai woh Start dabane par mana ho jata hai. Orders dein, ya shipment plan paste kijiye; dono mein se ek zaroori hai. Kab use karein Jab Order Console ke orders ke pieces pack karne hon.

parts|fab|ye Mark checked kis kaam ka ha.text: Mark checked — Fabric Inventory par button: Is printer delivery ko store me check kiya hua mark karta hai; ye To cross-check ginti se hat jaati hai. Edit right chahiye.

parts|fgi|what happens if i press Reason.text: Reason on the entry — box on Finished Goods: The reason written on the entry; correct it if needed. What it's for Shows the reason that is on the entry now, so you can fix it in the same request. How it works It starts with the current reason; change it only if it is wrong. If unchanged it is not sent as a change. When to use it When the reason written at entry was wrong or missing.

parts|ka|₹ / piece किसलिए है.text: ₹ / piece — Karigar Analysis पर कॉलम: उस article का प्रति पीस औसत मज़दूरी मूल्य: रकम ÷ पीस।

parts|fgi|Edit ka kya matlab hota hai.text: Edit — Finished Goods par button: Is SKU ka Edit kholta hai: gina hua stock, re-order level aur tag sahi kijiye. Edit rights chahiye. Yeh kis liye hai Ek hi jagah SKU ki ginti, chetavani-seema aur tag sudharne deta hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Ek dialog khulta hai jisme In stock (counted) , Why it changed , Re-order level aur Tag hain. Badli ginti count-correction row ki tarah save hoti hai; tag ke vikalp Listed, Need listing, Discontinue aur Etsy hain. Sirf edit ka right walon ke liye. Kab use karein Shelf ki ginti ke baad, ya SKU ko Need listing/Discontinue tag karte samay.

parts|fba|what does Pieces shipped show.text: Pieces shipped — box on FBA Dispatch: Only when shipping one row: how many pieces are going. It cannot be more than the open pieces. What it's for Lets you ship part of one dispatch when not all pieces can go. How it works Shown only when you press Ship on one row, not for ticked rows. It starts at the open pieces. Lowering it needs a reason below; it cannot go above the open pieces. When to use it When some pieces are damaged or not in the plan.

parts|fab|Track button kya karta h.text: Track — Fabric Inventory par button: Is item ke liye Store movements & cross-check kholta hai: har movement — kaun printer, kaun order, kaun karigar, kab.

parts|hr|ye Cancelled after this was tak.text: Cancelled after this was taken in. Still owed. — Finance & HR par note: Maal lene ke baad is delivery ka order cancel hua; payment abhi bhi dena hai. Yeh kis liye hai Samjhata hai ki radd hua order bill mein kyun dikhta hai: yeh delivery pehle sweekar ho chuki thi. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Nishan delivery ki window mein order number ke paas hota hai. Mouse rakhne par "Cancelled after this was taken in. Still owed." dikhta hai. Woh pieces Kept aur vendor ke kul mein bane rehte hain. Kab use karein Jab delivery ki pankti par "cancelled" nishan ho.

parts|article|what happens if i press SK.text: This is on Press Inventory , not on this screen. Press Edit on the row, change Pieces or Remarks and press Save . The SKU cannot change; the entry date and Delete are for admins only. What it's for To correct a wrongly typed old press entry. How it works Press Edit on the row; it is shown only to accounts with "Correct production entries" (or admin), others see a dash. Change Pieces (at least 1) or Remarks ; the SKU is shown but cannot change. Pieces stay within what the order allows, and a month that is frozen is locked. The entry date and Delete are for admins. When to use it When an old entry has the wrong pieces or a note is missing.

parts|ord|To quilt team किसलिए है.text: To quilt team — Order Console पर बटन: इस क्विल्ट लाइन को क्विल्ट टीम को सौंपा हुआ दर्ज करता है, आपके नाम और समय के साथ; Can edit production entries चाहिए। यह किस लिए है रज़ाई का काम अलग रज़ाई टीम करती है। यह लाइन पर लिखता है किसने कब दी, ताकि शक न रहे। यह कैसे काम करता है यह सिर्फ़ रज़ाई लाइनों पर दिखता है, production entry edit कर सकने वालों को। To quilt team दबाएँ। लाइन पर आपका लॉगिन और समय दर्ज होता है, और Quilt कॉलम में with the quilt team और तारीख दिखती है। जल्दी हो गया तो Undo quilt दबाएँ। कब इस्तेमाल करें जब रज़ाई की लाइन प्रोडक्शन से रज़ाई टीम को जाए।

parts|fgi|what happens if i press pieces.text: pieces of this order in the India Store — note on Finished Goods: The bracket number is how many pieces of this order are in the India Store, when fewer than ordered. What it's for Warns you before you scan that the store may not hold enough of an order. How it works It shows next to an order only when the pieces of that order in the India Store are fewer than ordered. Scans stop at that number, then show amber. When to use it When the Left figure is lower than the Ordered figure.

parts|gdesk|Our RFD challan no. किसलिए ह.text: Our RFD challan no. — Greige Desk पर बॉक्स: Processor को हमारा challan number, सेव करते समय अपनी series में अपने आप मिलता है। यह किस लिए है प्रोसेसर को हर पार्सल हमारे अपने challan नंबर के साथ जाता है, ताकि गाड़ी का काग़ज़ और register मिलें। यह कैसे काम करता है यह बंद दिखता है, अपनी RFD श्रृंखला में, पिछले से एक आगे। अंतिम नंबर Issue to RFD दबाते समय लिया जाता है। एक नंबर दो बार इस्तेमाल नहीं होता। कब इस्तेमाल करें greige भेजते समय हर बार दिखता है; कुछ लिखना नहीं होता।

parts|gdesk|By PO tab ka kya matlab hota.text: By PO tab — Greige Desk par button: Greige PO ki list; number batata hai kitne hain. Yeh kis liye hai Greige ko purchase order ke roop mein dikhata hai: kya kharida, kisse, aur kitna aaya. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Har row ek PO hai; arrow uski lines aur uske saamne aaye challan kholta hai. Row ke buttons agla kaam karte hain: receive, issue to RFD, receive RFD. Number batata hai kitne PO hain. Kab use karein Greige kharid par kaam karte waqt aam shuruaati view.

parts|so|what does Work booked show.text: Work booked — column on Sales Orders: Work already recorded on the line — cut, issued, received, pressed. Deleting the line does not delete this work. What it's for It warns whoever decides that a line is not empty: real work may already be sitting on it. How it works It lists pieces cut, issued, received and pressed against the order and SKU, or "none". In Deletion requests it is red when anything is booked; if the line is already gone from the order book it shows what the request saw. Deleting the line does not delete this work: it keeps its Order ID and stops counting against any line. Pressed counts old press entries or QC-passed pieces, whichever is larger, because pressing is no longer recorded. When to use it Check it before every delete.

parts|ord|Show … more button kya karta h.text: Show … more — Order Console par button: Dikh rahi lines ke neeche agli 600 lines dikhata hai. Yeh kis liye hai Screen tez rakhne ke liye pehle sirf nayi lines banti hain. Ye screen chhode bina aur lines laata hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Table ke upar ka message batata hai kitni lines dikhti hain aur Export sab ko leta hai. Show N more dabaiye: neeche 600 tak aur lines judti hain. Seedhe line tak pahunchne ke liye filter ya search bhi use karein. Kab use karein Jab dhoondhi ja rahi line pehli 600 se purani ho.

parts|fgi|ye Ordered kis kaam ka hai.text: Ordered — Finished Goods par column: Us line par orders jitne pieces maangte hain unka kul jod; sirf Left store mein jitna hai utne tak seemit rehta hai. Yeh kis liye hai Dikhata hai ki is SKU ke liye orders kul kitna maangte hain, taaki pack karne wale ko kaam ka aakar dikhe. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Yeh us line ke saare orders ki maang ka jod hai. Agar store mein kam maal hai to asal mein pack hone wala kam hota hai: woh Left mein dikhta hai, yahan nahi. Kab use karein Yeh dekhne ke liye ki shipment mein SKU ke kitne pieces hone hain.

parts|fgi|what happens if i press Start.text: Start another session — button on Finished Goods: After Finish, closes this session and opens a fresh Pack & verify. What it's for One packing session makes one packing list; this starts the next shipment cleanly. How it works Appears after Finish with the message Done. Pressing it closes this session and opens a fresh Pack & verify . A finished list refuses more scans, so use this to pack more. When to use it After finishing one shipment and before starting another.

parts|so|Upload किसलिए है.text: Upload — Sales Orders पर बटन: भरी लाइनों की फ़ाइल पढ़कर लाइनें जोड़ता या बदलता है; एक भी ग़लत लाइन हो तो पूरी फ़ाइल रुक जाती है। यह किस लिए है एक बार में सैकड़ों lines order पर डाल देता है, हर एक टाइप करने की ज़रूरत नहीं। यह कैसे काम करता है .csv या .xlsx file चुनिए। हर पंक्ति जाँची जाती है: master में SKU, मात्रा, order type, तारीखें। कोई भी पंक्ति गलत हो तो कुछ भी load नहीं होता और पहली गलतियाँ पंक्ति संख्या के साथ दिखती हैं। अगर form पर lines पहले से हों तो सवाल आता है: OK से नई lines जुड़ती हैं, Cancel से सब बदल जाता है। Negative मात्रा पहले से order में लगी मात्रा में से घटाती है (B2B में नहीं)। B2B में बिना SKU वाली rows को save पर code मिलता है और sheet में चिपकी तस्वीरें भी पढ़ी जाती हैं। कब इस्तेमाल करें जब order में मुट्ठी भर से ज़्यादा lines हों।

parts|pmdb|In the app ka kya matlab hota.text: In the app — Master Database par column: App ki apni vendor list mein milta vendor code, ya 'not in the app's vendor list'. Yeh kis liye hai Orders mein use hone wali app ki apni vendor list hai. Yeh dikhata hai ki yahan ka vendor us list mein bhi hai ya nahi. Kab use karein Milan naam se hota hai; milne par app ka vendor code aur category dikhti hai, warna "not in the app's vendor list". Jis vendor ko abhi Masters mein jodna hai use pehchanne ke liye.

parts|fgi|what does W cm show.text: W cm — box on Finished Goods: Box width in cm.

parts|gdesk|Supplement PO button kya kar.text: Supplement PO — Greige Desk par button: Jab line 10% chhoot se upar ho: extra metre ka usi supplier par supplement PO banata hai, jo isi challan par receive hota hai. Yeh kis liye hai Ek line baaki maal ke saath 10% tak zyada le sakti hai. Usse upar ke metre ka alag supplement PO banta hai, taaki woh darj rahein. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Type kiye metre 10% chhoot paar karein to laal sandesh ke saath + Supplement PO button dikhta hai. Dabane par note aata hai ki mool PO ke baad -S1, -S2 number ka supplement PO extra ko cover karega. Yeh usi supplier par banta hai aur extra isi challan par receive hota hai. Naya PO challan save karte waqt banta hai. Kab use karein Jab supplier PO se 10% se zyada bheje.

parts|ka|ye First column (Karigar, Artic.text: First column (Karigar, Article or Department) — Karigar Analysis par column: Karigar Analysis Karigar Analysis pehla column: grouping box mein jo chuna ho — Karigar Analysisrigar, article ya department. Yeh kis liye hai Ek hi table karigar, article ya department ke hisaab se padhi ja sakti hai, aur yeh pehla column wahi naam deta hai jo chuna gaya. Kab use karein Grouping box badalne par yeh heading aur rows badal jaati hain.

parts|so|what happens if i press Referen.text: Reference — box on Sales Orders: Your own reference, such as an old system number; the app still gives the real order number. What it's for Lets you keep the number the order had in your old system or sheet, so it can be found by that name. How it works Optional text, saved as the order's legacy reference. It does not replace the order number; the app always gives the real one. A file upload with a Legacy Order ID column fills this box too. When to use it When moving an order over from an old sheet or system.

parts|gdesk|Due on किसलिए है.text: Due on — Greige Desk पर कॉलम: जिस दिन supplier को यह line देनी है। यह किस लिए है यह मिल की वादा की गई तारीख़ है, और तय करती है कि PO देर से माना जाए या नहीं। यह कैसे काम करता है हर लाइन की अपनी तारीख़ होती है; PO अपनी सबसे बाद की due date के बाद देर से माना जाता है। देर वाला Sent या Part received PO कितने दिन देर से है यह दिखाता है। कब इस्तेमाल करें जब मिल से पूछताछ करनी हो।

parts|so|Color ka kya matlab hota hai.text: Color — Sales Orders par column: Buyer ka diya colour ka naam. Yeh kis liye hai Colour se tay hota hai ki kaun-sa kapda aur print lagega, isliye buyer ka colour naam line par rakha jata hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai B2B lines par text box (sheet ka column Color; "colour" bhi padha jata hai). Approve hone par agar master me SKU ka colour nahi hai to yeh order book me jata hai. Order dialog me har SKU ke liye ise tab tak badal sakte hain jab tak us par cutting nahi hui; badlav darj rehte hain. Kab use karein Jab buyer aisa colour bataye jo master se alag ho.

parts|fab|what does The printer still ho.text: The printer still holds pieces for that very order — the delivery has not been entered in — note on Fabric Inventory: The printer still holds pieces for that order — their delivery has not been entered in the app yet.

parts|ka|All departments button kya kart.text: All departments — Karigar Analysis par option: Karigar Analysis par sabhi department ke Karigar Analysisrigar dikhata hai. Yeh kis liye hai Alag departments ki raftaar alag hoti hai. Yeh option filter hata deta hai. Kab use karein Kisi ek department ko dekhne ke baad sab karigars phir dekhne ke liye chuniye.

parts|gdesk|ye Terms of delivery kis kaa.text: Terms of delivery — Greige Desk par box: Optional delivery terms, jaise hamare godown tak, bhaada chukaya. PO par chhapti hain. Yeh kis liye hai Saaf likhta hai ki mill ko kaise aur kahan deliver karna hai, taaki order kaagaz par spasht rahe. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Optional; Payment, dispatch & delivery terms hisse mein. Jaisa likha waisa PO par chhapta hai. Kab use karein Jab delivery ki koi shart likhit mein rakhni ho.

parts|fgi|what happens if i press Reopen.text: Reopen — button on Finished Goods: Reopens a closed box so the next scans go into it. What it's for Sometimes a piece must go into a box you already closed; this opens it again. How it works Shown on closed boxes in the box list. Press it: scans go into that box from now on; an empty box that was open is dropped. When to use it When a carton was closed too early.

parts|gdesk|Greige fabric for the PO lin.text: Greige fabric for the PO line — Greige Desk पर विकल्प: PO line का greige fabric चुनें; RFD fabric और description Master data से आते हैं। यह किस लिए है यहाँ एक चुनाव से खरीदा जाने वाला greige और उससे बनने वाला RFD तय होता है, इसलिए दोनों में फ़र्क़ नहीं आता। यह कैसे काम करता है सूची में Greige & RFD fabric master के greige नाम हैं। एक चुनने पर बगल में RFD कपड़ा और विवरण भर जाते हैं। एक ही PO पर और कपड़ों के लिए और लाइनें जोड़ें। कब इस्तेमाल करें PO की हर लाइन लिखते समय।

parts|pbase|All colors ka kya matlab hot.text: All colors — Job Work Register par option: Ek colour ki entries dikhata hai.

parts|shop|what does DHL CSV show.text: DHL CSV — option on Shopify Orders: The DHL CSV upload file. Needs an invoice number and date on each order and an HS code on each SKU. What it's for The same DHL customs details in CSV form, for DHL's CSV upload. How it works Pick DHL CSV and press Export . Each order needs a complete invoice pair (GST or non-GST number and date), and each SKU an HS code. A message names anything missing and no file is written; fill it under Invoice & customs in the order. When to use it When DHL asks for the CSV version of the file.

parts|flow|Challan button kya karta h.text: Challan — Production flow par column: Challan number aur date. Yeh kis liye hai Printer ko diye har paper ki pehchaan. Isi number se printer, store aur office ek hi cloth ki baat karte hain. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Printed fabric in ki By challan list me: bold me challan number aur uske neeche date. Khule challan upar aate hain, band wale neeche; test order par TEST ka nishaan hota hai. Cancel hua challan bilkul nahi dikhta. Kab use karein Jab koi challan dhundhna ho ya dekhna ho ki kaun se paper abhi khule hain.

parts|flow|ye … · issued … on … · … stil.text: … · issued … on … · … still out — Production flow par button: Chuniye kis karigar ka issue wapas aaya; woh Job Work receive khulta hai. Yeh kis liye hai Ek line ek se zyada karigar ko di ja sakti hai. Ye chunne deta hai ki kis karigar ka maal lauta. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Tab dikhta hai jab line ke ek se zyada issue karigar ke paas baaki hon. Har button mein karigar, issue kiye pieces, issue ki date aur kitne bahar hain, ye dikhta hai. Ek dabane par uska Job Work receive khulta hai. Sirf ek issue khula ho to seedha wahin pahunchta hai. Job Work Register ka right chahiye. Kab use karein Jab karigar taiyaar pieces lautaye.

parts|flow|what happens if i press Make.text: Make challan — button on Production flow: Asks how many pieces of each size go now, fills the oldest orders first, then opens the challan form. What it's for Lets the RFD team send cloth by size: type how many pieces of each size go now and the oldest orders get filled first. How it works It is on the printer's band in the Challan by size (pcs) view. It shows only for a printer that has been chosen; cutting-route lines have no printer. It opens "Challan by size" with the pieces each fabric and size still owes, ready to be changed. The preview below lists, size by size, which orders those pieces go to, oldest first. Review challan → opens the ordinary challan form with those lines and pieces filled in. When to use it When the printer needs one size at a time across many orders.

parts|pbase|Job Work register table किसल.text: Job Work register table — Job Work Register पर जानकारी: रजिस्टर के कॉलम: Issue Date, Karigar, Item, Qty Issued, Qty Received, Progress ring, Status, Actions और Entered by। यह किस लिए है ये register के कॉलम हैं। मिलकर बताते हैं कि किसके पास क्या है और हर काम कहाँ तक पहुँचा। यह कैसे काम करता है Issue Date : दिया गया दिन और समय। Karigar : नाम व employment type। Item : चित्र, article या subtype, colour, size, SKU, order (या "custom" टैग)। Qty Issued और Qty Received : पीस की संख्या। Progress : एक रिंग जो issued में से लौटे पीस का हिस्सा (received + rejected) दिखाती है। Status : Pending, In Progress या Completed, साथ में pending और rejected संख्या। Actions : Receive, Edit या Correction और ⋯ मेनू। Entered by : किसने दर्ज किया। पहले कॉलम का टिक पंक्ति चुनता है। कब इस्तेमाल करें किसी karigar का काम कहाँ है, यह देखने के लिए पंक्ति को पढ़ें।

parts|vord|Select all ka kya matlab hota.text: Select all — Vendor Orders par button: Ready to give a printer ke har SKU ko tick karta hai. Yeh kis liye hai Jab list ke zyadatar SKU printer ko dene hon to ek-ek tick karne se bachata hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Vendor Orders screen par Reserve ke andar, Ready to give a printer heading ke theek neeche ke buttons me. Us list ke har SKU par tick lagata hai; paas ka counter batata hai kitne chune gaye aur kitne pieces. Clear saare tick hata deta hai. Kab use karein Jab zyadatar ya saare ready SKU printer ko jane hon.

parts|mst|what does e.g. Greige Sheeting.text: e.g. Greige Sheeting 67 — box on Masters: In Fabric type, an admin types the greige name sent to the mill for this fabric. What it's for The mill is ordered greige cloth under its own name, which is often different from the finished fabric name. This is where that name is kept. How it works On the Fabric type list the Greige name (what the mill is sent) box shows this example as a hint. An admin types the name and it saves when they leave the box. One greige name can belong to one fabric only. Clearing the box shows a message that the fabric cannot go on a greige order. When to use it When a new fabric is added and you must say which greige it is bought as.

parts|fgi|Auto — oldest orders first but.text: Auto — oldest orders first — Finished Goods par option: Pieces un orders me baant-ta hai jinka ye SKU store me hai, purane pehle (FBA me Amazon order pehle). Yeh kis liye hai Default vikalp, taaki order haath se na chunna pade. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Pieces pehle un sabse purane orders ko jate hain jinke paas is SKU ka maal store mein hai. Send to FBA mein Amazon orders pehle milte hain; issue mein woh baaki orders ke baad aate hain. Box ke neeche ki line batati hai ki pieces kahan jayenge. Kab use karein Jab aapko farq nahi padta ki pieces kis order ko milein.

parts|fgi|ye L cm kis kaam ka hai.text: L cm — Finished Goods par box: Box ki lambai cm me; pichhle box ke naap se bhara aata hai. Yeh kis liye hai Packing list aur shipment ke wazan ki ganna ke liye carton ka size chahiye. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai L cm , W cm aur H cm mein lambai, chaudai aur unchai cm mein likhiye. Yeh aapke aakhiri band box ka size lekar shuru hota hai, isliye samaan size ke cartons par type nahi karna padta. Kab use karein Har baar jab carton band karein.

parts|pbase|what happens if i press Anyo.text: Anyone's entry — option on Job Work Register: Shows entries made or changed by one person, or by anyone. What it's for Shows what a particular office person entered or later changed, to trace mistakes or check someone's work. How it works Lists everyone who entered or edited a row. A row shows if that person entered it or changed it. The same names appear in the Entered by column. When to use it When reviewing one person's entries or tracing a wrong figure.

parts|fgi|Waiting to be counted in किसलि.text: Waiting to be counted in — Finished Goods पर विकल्प: प्रेस से भेजे गए वे पीस दिखाता है जो अभी स्टोर में गिने नहीं गए; गिनने तक वे स्टॉक नहीं हैं। यह किस लिए है Press से आए transfers की list जिन्हें store ने अभी गिना नहीं। Count it in दबाकर असली गिनती भरने तक ये stock नहीं हैं। कब इस्तेमाल करें जब press से पीस सच में पहुँचें, या drop-down के पास पीली संख्या दिखे।

parts|pbase|Reject ka kya matlab hota ha.text: Reject — Job Work Register par button: Correction mana karta hai; kaaran likhna zaroori hai, poochhne wala use dekhega. Entry nahi badalti. Yeh kis liye hai Jo sudhar sahi nahi use mana karta hai, aise karan ke saath jise maangne wala padh sake. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Ek box poochhta hai: "Why is it refused?" Khali karan nahi chalta. Maang band ho jati hai aur entry jaisi thi waisi rehti hai. Kab use karein Jab manga gaya badlav galat lage ya zaroori na ho.

parts|mst|what does Refresh show.text: Refresh — button on Masters: Reads the master lists and the master database again, so you see the latest changes. What it's for Masters are read when the screen opens. If another admin changed a list meanwhile, this brings you the latest. How it works Press Refresh : the master lists and the Master Database are read again. The table redraws with the latest rows and counts. Your own saved changes are already shown without it. When to use it When a colleague says they just added a row and you cannot see it.

parts|fgi|FBA account button kya karta h.text: FBA account — Finished Goods par box: FBA account chuniye (Ridhi FBA ya CPC FBA) jiske liye shipment hai. Yeh kis liye hai Amazon jane wale pieces do seller accounts mein se ek ke hote hain, aur packing list tatha FBA rows par sahi account hona chahiye. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Start dabane se pehle Ridhi FBA ya CPC FBA chuniye. Account packing list aur Finish se bani Send to FBA rows par save hota hai. Start ke baad yeh band ho jata hai. Kab use karein Amazon ke liye har packing session ki shuruat mein.

parts|pcut|ye All subtypes kis kaam ka h.text: All subtypes — Cutting Data par option: Ek subtype ki cutting dikhata hai. Yeh kis liye hai Article ke andar ek design type tak list chhoti karta hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Subtype chuniye; phir Colour aur Size lists sirf match karte maan dikhati hain. Yeh baaki filters ke saath milkar kaam karta hai. Kab use karein Jab ek design range dekhni ho.

parts|shop|what happens if i press Sign.text: Sign out : Signs you out of the app on this device.

parts|pbase|Issued किसलिए है.text: Issued — Job Work Register पर विकल्प: सिर्फ़ issue की तारीख देखता है। यह किस लिए है चुनी तारीख़ों में जो दिया गया वह दिखाता है, चाहे लौटा हो या नहीं। यह कैसे काम करता है सिर्फ़ issue तारीख़ को From और To से मिलाया जाता है। कब इस्तेमाल करें किसी अवधि में कितना काम गया, यह देखने के लिए।

parts|india|Import ka kya matlab hota ha.text: Import — India Stock par button: Band hai: India stock Finished Goods se aata hai, upload ki zarurat nahi. Receive, issue aur Send to FBA, Finished Goods me kijiye.

parts|ord|what does Closed from Shopify.text: Closed from Shopify — note on Order Console: The line was closed from Shopify; hover to see the date.

parts|flow|Every article button kya kart.text: Every article — Production flow par option: Har article ki lines dikhata hai; chhaantne ke liye ek chuniye.

parts|pack|ye Net kis kaam ka hai.text: Net — Packing List par column: Box ka net weight: har line ka qty × ek piece ka weight, jod kar, kg me. Yeh kis liye hai Net weight sirf saaman ka weight hai, jo customs aur Amazon dono mangte hain. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Har line ki quantity × per-piece weight ka jod, kilo me. Jis SKU ka per-piece weight nahi uska yogdan 0 hota hai, isliye Per SKU weight bharne tak net kam dikh sakta hai. Kab use karein Open me, box ka weight jaanchte samay.

parts|repl|what happens if i press ⇄ Mov.text: ⇄ Move from AWD — option on Replenishment: Shows SKUs where AWD holds stock, the SKU sells, and FBA has under 30 days of cover — move that stock from AWD to FBA. What it's for It lists SKUs whose stock is waiting in AWD while FBA runs low, so you can move it instead of shipping from India. How it works Pick ⇄ Move from AWD in the Need box. A SKU shows if AWD holds stock, it sells, and FBA (warehouse + inbound) has under 30 days of cover. The AWD Available cell shows an amber ⇄ . When to use it Before sending anything new from India for a low SKU.

parts|prod|📦 Ship from India किसलिए है.text: अगर यह मैसेज दिखे: ERP इसलिए रुका क्योंकि उसका कोई नियम पूरा नहीं हुआ — लाल मैसेज बताता है कौन सा। ठीक करें: मैसेज जो कहे वो करें, फिर बटन दोबारा दबाएँ। समझ न आए तो एडमिन को मैसेज बताएँ। यह Shopify Orders का मैसेज है।

parts|fgi|Order Console ka kya matlab ho.text: Order Console — Finished Goods par option: Receipt Order Console ke order par hai; list se Order No chuniye. Yeh kis liye hai Zyada tar receipts Order Console ke orders ke hote hain, yeh pieces ko unmein se ek se jodta hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Order list mein sirf wahi orders dikhte hain jinmein yeh SKU hai, saath mein ordered, received aur baaki pieces. Yeh sabse purane us order par shuru hota hai jiske pieces abhi baaki hain. Jis order mein is SKU ki line nahi, woh mana ho jata hai. Kab use karein Jab Order Console ke order ke taiyar pieces store mein aayein.

parts|pack|what does Invoice # show.text: Your question fits more than one answer. Which one do you mean? Invoice # · Packing List (box) Invoice # · Packing List (column) Invoice # · Packing List (box)

parts|shop|e.g. 07001 button kya karta h.text: e.g. 07001 — Shopify Orders par box: USA warehouse ka 5 ankon ka zip likhiye; ye agli baar ke liye yaad rehta hai.

parts|gdesk|ye Ordered kis kaam ka hai.text: Ordered — Greige Desk par column: Is line par mangaye metres. Yeh kis liye hai Jo metre aapne mill se mange; line ki baaki baatein isi se tauli jati hain. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai PO likhte samay tay hota hai aur Edit se badla jata hai. Table ke neeche sab lines ka jod hota hai. Kab use karein Jab order aur delivery ki tulna karni ho.

parts|pack|what happens if i press Done.text: Done — write Send to FBA — button on Packing List: Writes one Send to FBA row per SKU into Finished Goods, taking the pieces out of stock; done once per list. What it's for This is where a packed shipment becomes real stock movement, so nothing has to be typed again in Finished Goods. How it works It needs a valid FBA account, at least one packed piece and the right to add stock entries, and checks the India Store holds enough of every SKU. It writes one Send to FBA row per SKU into Finished Goods, with the boxes and the orders it was packed for. The FBA Dispatch tab then has them. Written once per list; if the rows already exist nothing is written twice. When it succeeds the scanner closes and a message gives the row count. When to use it When the whole shipment is packed and ready to leave.

parts|india|Not in the Amazon snapshot A.text: Not in the Amazon snapshot AND not in the Catalog — check the SKU spelling, or it really i — India Stock पर जानकारी: Not on Amazon: SKU न Amazon के stock data में है न catalogue में — spelling जाँचें, या सच में listed नहीं है।

parts|vend|Change my PIN ka kya matlab h.text: Change my PIN — Vendor Portal par button: Change my PIN kholta hai, jahan aap naya PIN rakhte hain jo sirf aapko pata ho; yeh cellphone aur PIN se sign in par hi dikhta hai. Yeh kis liye hai PIN ek password hai aur office ka diya PIN doosron ko bhi pata hai. Ye button printer ko use badalne deta hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Sirf use dikhta hai jisne cellphone aur PIN se sign in kiya. Ek chhoti window khulti hai: The PIN I use now , My new PIN , Type it again . Save karne ke liye Change it dabaiye. Kab use karein Pehle sign in par, aur uske baad kabhi-kabhi.

parts|adj|what does Filter id / order /.text: Filter id / order / SKU / product — box on Adjustments: Type an Adjustmentsustment id, order number, SKU or product to find jobs. What it's for Finds a job quickly without scrolling a long list. How it works Type part of an adjustment id, Shopify order number, SKU or product name. The customer name and the sizes also match. The list narrows a moment after you stop typing, and works together with the state and dates. When to use it When someone asks about one order, SKU or adjustment id.

parts|repl|Export button kya karta h.text: Export — Replenishment par button: Screen par dikh rahi rows hi CSV file mein download karta hai. Yeh kis liye hai Yeh table ko filter ke anusaar jyon ka tyon spreadsheet mein le jata hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Filters lagaiye, phir Export dabaiye; button par rows ki ginti dikhti hai. Saari filter ki hui rows ki CSV download hoti hai, sirf 200 ki nahi. Message batata hai kitne SKU download hue. Kab use karein Jab list ERP ke bahar share ya jaanchni ho.

parts|pack|ye Shipment date to kis kaam.text: Shipment date to — Packing List par note: Sirf is date ya usse pehle ki packing lists dikhaiye. Yeh kis liye hai Table ko kisi din tak ki shipments tak seemit karta hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Ye har list ki shipment Date se milata hai. Daayre ke liye Shipment date from ke saath use karo; Clear ise khali karta hai. Kab use karein Kisi aakhri date se pehle ki shipments dekhne ke liye.

parts|pbase|what happens if i press Move.text: Move completed entries — button on Job Work Register: Admins only: moves completed entries that came back before today to the completed section; they stay on every screen and total. What it's for Keeps the register quick: old finished entries go to a separate section so the page does not load them every time. How it works Admins only. It first tells you how many complete entries (those that came back before today) will move and asks you to confirm. They stay on every screen, total, payout and report; only where they are stored changes. This also happens by itself; the button forces it now. When to use it Rarely; only if you want it done now rather than waiting for the automatic move.

parts|fgi|Undo last scan किसलिए है.text: Undo last scan — Finished Goods पर बटन: आख़िरी स्कैन वापस लेता है। यह किस लिए है बिना हाथ से कुछ delete किए गलत scan सुधारता है। यह कैसे काम करता है आख़िरी सही scan को उसके box से निकालकर piece को order line में लौटा देता है। और पीछे जाने के लिए फिर दबाएँ, पर सिर्फ़ इसी बार बैठकर किए scans वापस हो सकते हैं। कब इस्तेमाल करें गलत piece box में scan होते ही।

parts|fgi|For which order * Auto — oldes.text: For which order * Auto — oldest orders first — Finished Goods par box: Issue ya FBA send me chuniye pieces kis order ke liye ja rahe hain; Auto purane order pehle leta hai. Yeh kis liye hai Store se nikalne wale pieces usi order ke naam gine jane chahiye jiske liye bane, taaki order ki pragati sahi rahe. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Issue ya Send to FBA mein SKU likhte hi dikhta hai. List mein ve orders hain jinke is SKU ke pieces store mein hain. Auto rehne dein to sabse purane se shuru hota hai, ya ek order chuniye, ya Not for an order chuniye. Kab use karein Jab bhi aap store se pieces nikalein ya bhejein.

parts|vend|what does By product one card.text: By product one card per SKU — option on Vendor Portal: Shows one card per SKU, with that SKU's lines from all your orders together. What it's for Printing is planned per design, not per order. One card per SKU adds the same design from every order, so it is printed together. How it works Choose By product in the view box (it is the starting choice). Each card adds the ordered quantity across orders and lists the order numbers. What the printer types stays against the real order line. When to use it When planning what to print today.

parts|flow|Fixed — send to PPC button ky.text: Fixed — send to PPC — Production flow par button: Theek karne ke baad ise dabaiye, What was done likhiye aur Send to PPC dabaiye; line phir PPC me jaati hai. Yeh kis liye hai Sudhari hui line ko note ke saath phir PPC ke saamne rakhta hai, taaki planning dobara shuru ho. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Pehle order ya master theek karein. Fixed — send to PPC dabaiye; What was done box khulta hai, ise khali nahi chhod sakte. Send to PPC dabaiye: line is laal card se hatkar plan hone ke liye PPC mein laut jati hai. PPC ne pehle jo kaha tha wo line ki history mein rehta hai. Ye admin aur PPC, Sales Orders, Order Console ya Shopify Orders wale account ko dikhta hai. Kab use karein Sales team ke order ya master sudharte hi.

parts|follow|ye The warehouse list is st.text: The warehouse list is still being read. — Ongoing Purchase Order par note: India Stock mein … ka matlab godown ki list abhi padhi ja rahi hai.

parts|gdesk|what happens if i press Grei.text: Greige has come on this line, so its fabric stays. — note on Greige Desk: On an edited PO line that has received greige: its fabric cannot be changed. What it's for Protects what has already been received: the fabric of a line cannot be swapped once its cloth is in. How it works It shows as a tooltip on the locked greige fabric box when you Edit a PO. Such a line cannot go below the metres already received, and has no remove ×. The supplier also stays fixed. When to use it When you edit a PO that already has deliveries.

parts|pcut|Filled in from the item on th.text: Filled in from the item on the left. Typing a SKU here works too and fills the item back. — Cutting Data पर जानकारी: SKU box: बाईं ओर के item से भरता है, या SKU लिखें तो item भर जाता है। यह किस लिए है जिसे SKU कोड पहले से पता है उसके लिए शॉर्टकट। यह कैसे काम करता है टाइप करते समय बॉक्स SKU की सूची सुझाता है। master में मिला SKU आर्टिकल टाइप, सबटाइप, रंग और साइज़ वापस भर देता है। SKU master database में न हो तो नीचे की लाइन बताती है और एंट्री सेव नहीं होती। कब इस्तेमाल करें जब SKU कटिंग पर्ची पर लिखा हो या याद हो।

parts|follow|Not found on Amazon (not in.text: Not found on Amazon (not in the Replenishment snapshot) — needs a listing — Ongoing Purchase Order par note: Laal Not listed tag: SKU Amazon par nahi mila, uski listing karni hai.

parts|shop|what does Who changed the lin.text: Who changed the line status — note on Shopify Orders: Hover the line status to see who typed it and when, or Nothing recorded yet.

parts|flow|Passed QC, not in India stock.text: Passed QC, not in India stock yet — accept or reject them — Production flow par note: QC pass aur accept/reject ka intezaar kar rahi lines ki ginti; kholne ke liye click kijiye. Yeh kis liye hai Finished Goods team ko chetata hai ki taiyaar pieces unke intezaar mein hain. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Finished Goods screen par hara number: wo lines jinke pieces QC pass hain aur India stock mein nahi hain. Click karne par From QC — to accept khulta hai. Kuch intezaar mein na ho ya flow band ho to chhipa rehta hai. Kab use karein Finished Goods kholte samay.

parts|pack|ye Orders (a new list) kis ka.text: Orders (a new list) — Packing List par box: Pack by order scan ke liye: ye nayi list kin orders ke liye hai; sirf jo wo abhi chahte hain wahi gina jaata hai. Yeh kis liye hai Pack by order scan har scan ko orders se milata hai, isliye box me sirf wahi jata hai jo ab bhi chahiye. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Comma se alag Order Console order numbers likho; jo Order Console me nahi hain wo naam sahit mana hote hain. Phir scanner sirf wahi ginta hai jo ye orders ab bhi chahte hain aur India Store de sakta hai, aur baaki ginti dikhata hai. Zaroori hai, jab tak aap uski jagah ya uske saath Amazon shipment plan paste na karo. Kab use karein Jab khaas orders poore karne wali shipment pack ho.

parts|vend|what happens if i press Searc.text: Search order no, SKU, fabric — box on Vendor Portal: Type an order number, SKU, fabric, colour, article or size to see only the orders that match. What it's for Finds one order or design fast without reading through a long list. How it works Type an order number, SKU, fabric, colour, article or size. The list narrows as you type. An SKU or colour search shows only the matching lines of an order; an order number shows the whole order. Clear filters empties it. When to use it Whenever the printer looks for one design or order.

parts|repl|Lead times used to decide whe.text: Lead times used to decide whether a month's shortfall can still be covered by sea, or has — Replenishment पर जानकारी: Lead days से तय होता है कि किसी महीने की कमी समुद्र से पूरी हो सकती है या हवाई जहाज़ से भेजनी होगी। ये सिर्फ़ इसी ब्राउज़र में याद रहते हैं।

parts|pmdb|+ Add vendor ka kya matlab ho.text: + Add vendor — Master Database par button: Sirf admin: Vendors page par naya vendor (greige, RFD, quilt filling, cutting ya runner) jodta hai. Yeh kis liye hai Vendor ki details jaise GSTIN, PAN aur contact yahan rakhi jaati hain, greige, taiyaar kapde, filling, cutting aur runner kaam ke liye. Naya vendor yahin se shuru hota hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Vendors view mein + Add vendor dabaiye (sirf admin). Vendor name aur Vendor type bhariye (dono zaroori); city aur state pehle se Jaipur aur Rajasthan hote hain. Phone (10 ank), pincode (6 ank), GSTIN aur PAN jaanche jaate hain. Ek hi type mein wahi naam dobara nahi liya jata. Masters ki app ki apni vendor list nahi badalti. Kab use karein Jab koi naya vendor joda jaye.

parts|repl|what does Type a number, or l.text: Type a number, or leave empty to go back to the calculated projection — note on Replenishment: Type your own Proj and press Enter; leave it empty to go back to the calculated figure.

parts|palloc|Capacity from history — m².text: Capacity from history — m² a week — Printer Allocation par option: Har printer ne hafte-dar-hafte asal mein kitne square metre diye, aur kitna abhi chhaapna hai, dikhata hai. Yeh kis liye hai Printers ko unke vaade se nahi, asal delivery se naapta hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Upar: chhapne ko bacha m², pieces, weeks of printing in hand , aur order hone wale kapde. Table: har printer ka har hafte ka m², pichla hafta, average, best hafta, kaam kiye hafte. Share of the need aur Weeks at this rate batate hain har ek ko kitna time lagega. Unpriced un deliver pieces ko ginta hai jinhe m² mein nahi badla ja saka. Kab use karein Jab tay karna ho ki kis printer ko kitna dena hai.

parts|pack|ye Blank uses net + packing w.text: Blank uses net + packing weight. Fill it in only from a scale. — Packing List par note: Khali chhodiye to net + packing weight lagega; sirf tarazu ka figure hi bhariye.

parts|shop|what happens if i press Sign.text: Sign in : Signs you in with the Email and Password typed above. What it's for This is the front door of the ERP. Your email and password decide which screens you see after you are in. How it works Type your email and password, then press Sign in (or press Enter in the Password box). A wrong email or password shows a red line: Wrong email or password. If it works, the app reads what your account may open and shows your first allowed screen. If your account has no screens you see a no-access message; if your email is not confirmed yet you see the confirm-email box. When to use it At the start of the day, and each time you have signed out or the page was closed.

parts|gdesk|Reopen the PO किसलिए है.text: Reopen the PO — Greige Desk पर बटन: बंद PO को फिर खोलता है, ताकि न आए metres फिर से बाकी गिने जाएँ। यह किस लिए है PO को वापस खोलता है, जब वह जल्दी बंद हो गया या सप्लायर बाद में और भेजे। यह कैसे काम करता है यह बंद PO पर दिखता है, “कितने मीटर नहीं आए” के नोट के पास। एक बार दबाने से बंद होना हट जाता है; पुष्टि नहीं पूछी जाती। PO फिर से बाकी मीटर दिखाता है और Receive लौट आता है। कब इस्तेमाल करें जब “नहीं आया” लिखा greige बाद में आ जाए।

parts|shop|Placed today ka kya matlab ho.text: Placed today — Shopify Orders par option: Aaj aaye order dikhata hai.

parts|cx|what does Cancel this line show.text: Cancel this line — button on Customer Orders: Marks the line Cancelled; nothing is issued for it. What it's for Takes a line out of the plan, for example when the customer cancelled. How it works Inside the Decide box on an Open line, shown in red. Sets the status to Cancelled; the row looks faded. Nothing is issued and no stock is taken. It cannot be undone on the line; an admin can delete it and upload it again. When to use it When the customer cancels or the line was not a real order.

parts|pack|+ A new packing list button k.text: + A new packing list — Packing List par option: Open list jaari rakhne ki jagah nayi packing list shuru karta hai; neeche uska title aur account bhariye. Yeh kis liye hai Har shipment ki apni list hoti hai, taaki nayi shipment purani me na mil jaye. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Ye Packing list drop-down me pehla option hai; ise chunkar Start scanning dabane par nayi list banti hai. Usi tarah ki khuli lists neeche title, date aur box ginti ke saath dikhti hain; ek chunne par usi me scan aage chalta hai. Jis list ke scans sirf is phone me ruke hain wo chihnit hoti hai aur khud chuni jati hai. Kab use karein Nayi shipment ki shuruaat me, ya adhoori shipment aage badhate samay.

parts|flow|ye Use the master data kis ka.text: Use the master data — Production flow par button: Purane plan ki jagah master ka fabric aur metres per piece line me daalta hai. Yeh kis liye hai Us line ko sudharta hai jiske purane plan ka fabric ya kapda per piece master data se alag hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Laal nishan ke paas aata hai jo batata hai ki master data kya kehta hai (fabric aur metres per piece). Dabaiye: master row ka fabric aur metres per piece boxes mein aa jate hain aur total dobara nikalta hai. Abhi kuch save nahi hota; rakhne ke liye plan save karein. Line ka fabric challan par lock ho to nahi dikhta. Kab use karein Jab laal master-data nishan wala purana plan badlein.

parts|shop|what happens if i press Can't.text: Can't ship — note on Shopify Orders: can't ship: hover to see Amazon's reason this speed cannot be used.

parts|fgi|who took the pieces किसलिए है.text: who took the pieces — Finished Goods पर बॉक्स: Send to FBA के लिए: जिसे पीस सौंपे गए।

parts|ord|… open line(s) behind this SKU.text: … open line(s) behind this SKU — Order Console par note: Is SKU ke peeche ki har khuli line ek saath tick karta hai. Yeh kis liye hai Ek box tick karne se us SKU ke sabhi khule order aa jate hain, har order alag tick nahi karna padta. Kab use karein Jab SKU ke saare order saath mein poore karne hon.

parts|ord|what does This article is not.text: This article is not cut — nothing to record — note on Order Console: not needed: this article is not cut, so there is no cutting to record. What it's for Some articles are not cut, so a cutting figure would mislead. The words say so. When to use it Read it in the Cut column; no cutting needs to be entered for that SKU.

parts|shop|Desktop view the computer lay.text: Desktop view the computer layout, scaled : Phone par computer wala layout chhota karke dikhata hai; page reload hota hai. Yeh kis liye hai Kuch kaam ke liye poori computer screen chahiye. Ye switch phone par wahi screen chhoti karke deta hai, phone layout ki jagah. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai More ke sabse neeche Desktop view par tap kijiye: page computer layout mein reload hota hai. Ye is visit tak rehta hai; app band karke dobara kholne par phone wala layout laut aata hai, ya menu ke neeche Phone view dabaiye. Page computer wala layout hota hai, jo phone ke hisaab se chhota kiya jaata hai. Kab use karein Jab kisi screen ki phone list na ho aur uski poori table chahiye.

parts|gdesk|ye Received kis kaam ka hai.text: Received — Greige Desk par column: Supplier ke challans se is line par ab tak aaye metres. Yeh kis liye hai Dikhata hai ki order ka kitna hissa sach mein aapke paas pahuncha. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Is PO ke saamne aaye supplier ke challan se nikala jata hai, likha nahi jata. Chhoti patti aaye hue hisse ko dikhati hai. Kab use karein Jab dekhna ho ki kitna aana baaki hai.

parts|qc|what happens if i press Employm.text: Employment type — option on Quality Control: Pick the employment type first; the Employee list then shows only people of that type. What it's for Narrows the Employee list to one kind of worker. How it works Pick the type first; the Employee suggestions then come from that type only. Required: Issue refuses without it. When to use it Before choosing the tailor.

parts|target|Article किसलिए है.text: Article — Revenue Target पर कॉलम: article (sub-category); SKU बँटवारा खोलने या बंद करने के लिए उसकी पंक्ति पर क्लिक करें। यह किस लिए है हर पंक्ति एक आर्टिकल है, जिस स्तर पर राजस्व लक्ष्य तय होता है। यह कैसे काम करता है पंक्तियाँ लक्ष्य की रकम के हिसाब से, बड़ी पहले; लक्ष्य बनने से पहले L90 $ के हिसाब से। set टैग का मतलब लक्ष्य हाथ से लिखा गया है। पंक्ति या तीर पर क्लिक करके उसके नीचे SKU और उनके पीस खोलें; फिर क्लिक करके बंद करें। कब इस्तेमाल करें योजना को ऊपर से नीचे देखते समय, सबसे बड़ी रकम पहले।

parts|repl|India stock does not stretch.text: India stock does not stretch to the end of this month — Replenishment par note: dry: is mahine mein India stock khatam ho jaata hai. Yeh kis liye hai Us mahine par nishan lagata hai jisme India stock khatam hoga, taaki faisla taala na jaaye. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Replenishment mein Supply columns: on chuna ho to kisi mahine ke ← India cell mein laal dry tag dikh sakta hai. Iska matlab hai ki us mahine ke ant tak India stock nahi chalega. Ek mahine mein na bacha maal agle mahine mein chalta hai. Kab use karein Jab tay karna ho ki kis mahine naya production order chahiye.

parts|pcut|what does All sizes show.text: All sizes — option on Cutting Data: Shows cutting of one size.

parts|shop|Password button kya karta h.text: Password : Apna password likhiye; yeh upar wale email se match hona chahiye.

parts|ord|ye Save all kis kaam ka hai.text: Save all — Order Console par button: Confirm ke baad grid mein likha har number save karta hai, SKU ke khule orders mein sabse purane se baantkar. Yeh kis liye hai Ek din ki cutting, issue aur receive kai SKU ki ek saath bharne ke liye, har SKU alag khole bina. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Grid mein figures bharein; upar ki Date sab entries par lagti hai. Save all dabaiye: ek box batata hai kya save hoga aur kya nahi, phir confirm maangta hai. Har SKU ki figure uske open Shopify orders mein, sabse purane se, baanti jaati hai; checks wahi jo single entry mein hote hain. Open orders ki zaroorat se zyada tabhi save hota hai jab Extra reason ho. Kab use karein Jab ek hi din kai SKU kate, diye ya wapas aaye hon.

parts|flow|what happens if i press Mark.text: Mark fabric ready — button on Production flow: Ready: says the fabric for this line is ready: fabric, metres (all of it) and where it is. What it's for A line does not always need a challan to a printer: the cloth may already be in the store or be arranged another way. This tells PPC and the store that the fabric for the line is ready. How it works On screen the button is called Ready (last in the stock-and-action cell). Its window is titled "Fabric ready". You confirm the fabric, the metres (all of what PPC raised; less is refused) and a note on where it is. The metres are then held for that line and taken off the free RFD, until the line is cut or issued. A cutting-route line goes to the cutting department this way, since it has no challan. If it was marked by mistake, the window has a tick Not ready after all — take it back . When to use it When the fabric for a line is ready without a challan to a printer.

parts|prod|Need = Air + Sea Req किसलिए ह.text: Need = Air + Sea Req — In Production पर विकल्प: NEED = SKU का Air Req + Sea Req; AWD Req नहीं जोड़ा जाता।

parts|ord|Balance ka kya matlab hota hai.text: Balance — Order Console par column: Abhi kitna aana baaki hai: quantity minus bheja. Yeh kis liye hai Request ki line ka kitna aana baaki hai, yeh dikhata hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Yeh maangi quantity minus vendor ka bheja hua hai. Sent ki tarah yeh tab dikhta hai jab request vendor order ban chuka ho. Kab use karein Jab poochtachh karni hai ya nahi tay karna ho.

parts|hr|what does Extra hours show.text: Extra hours — option on Finance & HR: Extra hours logged for staff, with From and To times, hours and whether they are authorised. What it's for The record of overtime: who stayed on, when, for how long, and whether an admin has approved it. How it works Columns: Date, Employee, Department, From, To, Hours, Status, Authorise, Entered by, Remarks, Edit. Newest first. The summary shows entries, total hours, hours awaiting authorisation and hours authorised. + Log extra hours adds an entry as Pending; admins use Authorise / Undo . The status drop-down filters by authorisation. When to use it Daily to log hours; weekly or at month-end for an admin to authorise them.

parts|fba|Returned to the store button k.text: Returned to the store — FBA Dispatch par option: Wo dispatches dikhata hai jinka har piece store me wapas aa gaya. Yeh kis liye hai Wo dispatch dikhata hai jinmein koi piece khula nahi kyunki sab store laut aaye. Kab use karein Ye dekhne ke liye ki kya lauta aur kyun.

parts|repl|ye Delivery date kis kaam ka.text: Delivery date — Replenishment par box: Purchase order: delivery ki ummeed wali date (ETA). Yeh kis liye hai Woh date jab maal aane ka vaada hai; stock ki yojana aur supplier se poochhtaachh ke liye. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Expected delivery ki date chuniye. Yeh PO ke saath save hoti hai. Supplier date badle to ise badliye. Kab use karein Jab supplier date de ya badle.

parts|fgi|what happens if i press Pack &.text: Pack & verify — button on Finished Goods: Opens Pack & verify: scan pieces against orders or an Amazon plan; Finish writes Send to FBA rows and the packing list. What it's for Packs an FBA shipment against the orders so only the right pieces go in, then writes the dispatch and packing list. How it works The button is shown only to people with Can add stock entries or Can edit finished goods. Pick the FBA account, enter orders or use Paste plan… , press Start . Scan pieces; wrong ones are blocked. Close box (F2) closes a box. Finish writes the Send to FBA rows and the packing list. When to use it When packing an FBA shipment at the computer.

parts|shop|From India · DHL / FedEx किसल.text: From India · DHL / FedEx — Shopify Orders पर बटन: Delivery days में, pickup date से India से DHL Express और FedEx International Priority की delivery का अंदाज़ा देता है। यह किस लिए है India से उड़ने वाले पार्सल का अंदाज़ा देता है, DHL Express और FedEx International Priority के हिसाब से। यह कैसे काम करता है Delivery days में From India · DHL / FedEx दबाएँ। Pickup in India की तारीख चुनें और ग्राहक की ज़िप लिखें। Check दबाएँ: DHL Express और FedEx International Priority के कार्य-दिन और पहुँचने की तारीखें दिखती हैं। कस्टम्स सही कागज़ात मानकर गिना जाता है; रुकने पर 1 से 3 दिन बढ़ते हैं। कब इस्तेमाल करें जब ऑर्डर India से सीधे कूरियर से ग्राहक को जाना हो।

parts|repl|SKU ka kya matlab hota hai.text: SKU — Replenishment par column: PO line: order kiya SKU. Yeh kis liye hai Har line mein mangaya ja raha product batata hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Har line ek SKU hai, jo Add SKU aur Add se judti hai. Ant ka ✕ line hatata hai. Sub-cat, Color aur Size SKU se bhar jate hain. Kab use karein Jab dekhna ho ki PO mein kya hai.

parts|shopify|what does Article show.text: Article — column on Shopify Stock: The product type, from the Master Database; grey italic means guessed from look-alike SKUs. What it's for Tells you what kind of product the SKU is (its sub-type, or its article type when there is no sub-type), so a code is readable at a glance. When to use it When you restock by product type.

parts|shop|Item button kya karta h.text: Item — Shopify Orders par column: Item, photo ke saath; "part" matlab order ke kuch hi pieces aaye.

parts|pack|ye By kis kaam ka hai.text: Ye Job Work Register par hai, is screen par nahi. Job Work Register kholiye, + New Job Work dabaiye, order, karigar aur item chuniye, pieces likhiye aur Issue dabaiye. Yeh kis liye hai Isse cut pieces karigar ko system me diye jaate hain, taaki register me pata rahe kis order ka kitna maal kiske paas hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai + New Job Work dabane par form khulta hai; button Close ho jata hai. Pehle order chuniye, phir Employment type… aur naam; item ke boxes usi order ke hisaab se kam ho jaate hain. Boxes ke neeche ki line batati hai kitne pieces issue ho sakte hain. Issue dabaiye: register me nayi line aati hai aur form khali ho jata hai. Kab use karein Jab bhi cut pieces karigar ko diye jaayein. Kyun Har issue kisi order se juda hota hai, taaki register jaan sake ki kiske paas kya baaki hai aur order ko abhi kitna chahiye. Kya karein + New Job Work dabaiye. — Select Order ID — mein order chuniye. Employment type… chuniye, phir list se Employee name chuniye. Article type , Subtype , Colour , Size chuniye — ya SKU likhiye. Issue pieces likhiye. Ek baar Issue dabaiye.

parts|rep|what happens if i press Sunday.text: Sunday to Saturday, the same weeks as Last week · received — note on Reports: Pick the week for Quality; the same Sunday-to-Saturday weeks as the other reports. What it's for Quality is read for one week at a time, using the same Sunday-to-Saturday weeks as the other reports so the numbers line up. How it works The box offers All time , This week so far and the last 12 weeks. It opens on last week. The hover text still names the old report Last week · received ; the weeks are the same as Last week · QC passed . When to use it When you pick the week for the Quality report.

parts|cx|Fulfil from India किसलिए है.text: Fulfil from India — Customer Orders पर बटन: इस ऑर्डर के नाम पर India Store से पीस इश्यू करता है और लाइन Fulfilled-India करता है; India स्टॉक काफ़ी होना चाहिए। सिर्फ़ एडमिन। यह किस लिए है इस order के नाम India finished-goods स्टोर से पीस देता है। यह कैसे काम करता है Decide बॉक्स के अंदर; जब तक In India, finished goods Qty पूरी न करे, फीका रहता है। यह Finished Goods में "Customer order" और order number नाम का issue लिखता है और लाइन Fulfilled-India करता है। दोनों एक साथ सेव होते हैं, और संदेश बताता है कि स्टोर में कितने पीस बचे। सिर्फ़ admin इस्तेमाल कर सकता है। कब इस्तेमाल करें जब Amazon लाइन पूरी न कर सके पर India स्टोर में पीस हों।

parts|ord|This order, start to finish ka.text: This order, start to finish — Order Console par note: Order number dabaiye to yeh order shuru se aakhir tak dikhega: har stage aur kahan ruka hai. Yeh kis liye hai Ye "order kahan hai" ka jawab kai screen dekhe bina ek click mein deta hai. Kab use karein Jab koi kisi order ki sthiti poochhe.

parts|top|what does Add a note (e.g. 'Fa.text: Add a note (e.g. 'Fabric ordered', 'Production started', 'Ready to ship') — box on Top ASIN Status: Production Status: write an update for this SKU, e.g. Fabric ordered, then press + Add note. What it's for Lets the production side leave a dated progress line for a SKU that anyone can read. How it works Opened from + Log in the Production Status column of Top ASIN Status. Type an update such as Fabric ordered, then press + Add note . The newest note shows in the cell and the full trail in this window. When to use it Whenever a SKU moves a step, from fabric to ready to ship.

parts|pcut|Clear button kya karta h.text: Clear — Cutting Data par button: Item, order, platform, person, search aur date ke filter khaali karta hai. Yeh kis liye hai Filter lagane ke baad poora register wapas laata hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Yeh platform, order, article, subtype, rang, size, vyakti, search box aur dono dates khali karta hai. Pehla box aur Used or not jaise hain waise rehte hain. Kab use karein Jab nayi khoj shuru karni ho.

parts|gdesk|ye Show what makes this up k.text: Show what makes this up — Greige Desk par note: Kisi figure par click kijiye to uske PO ya lots khulte hain, har ek ke agle step ke button ke saath. Yeh kis liye hai Har stock figure khud ko samjhata hai, alag report ki zaroorat nahi. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Greige order , Greige in store , At RFD processor aur RFD on shelf columns ke aankde button hain. Ek dabaiye to row ke neeche list khulti hai; arrow upar ho jata hai. Ek baar mein ek hi khulta hai; dobara dabane par band. Dash ka matlab peeche kuch nahi hai. Kab use karein Jab kisi figure ko samajhna ho.

parts|pbase|what happens if i press Expo.text: Export selected — button on Job Work Register: Downloads only the ticked rows as a CSV file. What it's for Export only a few entries rather than the whole filtered register. How it works In the bar at the bottom when rows are ticked. Saves a CSV file of just the ticked rows, with the same columns as Export . When to use it When you want to share or check a few entries outside the app.

parts|rep|Article type किसलिए है.text: Article type — Reports पर कॉलम: पीस किस article type के हैं।

parts|pbase|Keep it ka kya matlab hota h.text: Keep it — Job Work Register par button: Admin: delete ki request band karta hai aur entry jaisi hai waisi rakhta hai. Yeh kis liye hai Hatane ki maang ko mana karta hai aur kaam darj rehne deta hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Sirf admin, Deletion requests list mein. Maang band ho jati hai; entry aur uske aankde jaise hain waise rehte hain. Kab use karein Jab entry sahi ho, ya hatane ki jagah sudhar chahiye.

parts|rep|what does Download these rows.text: Download these rows — button on Reports: Downloads the part-received Job Work rows whose pieces have no receiving date yet.

parts|flow|Use for another order button.text: Use for another order — Production flow par button: Sirf admin: usi printer aur fabric ki doosri line ke liye us kapde se challan banata hai; store se kuch nahi jaata. Yeh kis liye hai Printer ke paas pade kapde ko dusre order mein istemaal karta hai, store se kapda nikle bina. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Sirf admin. Demand mein usi printer aur fabric ke intezaar wali line chunein, phir kitna likhein. Khade kapde se usi printer ke liye naya challan banta hai aur line ka fabric diya hua mark hota hai. Ye khade kapde ya line ki baaki zaroorat se zyada nahi ho sakta. Aisi line na ho to kehta hai ki pehle is printer ke liye ek plan karein. Kab use karein Jab naye order ko wahi fabric chahiye jo purane printer ke paas hai.

parts|rep|ye Nothing of this was pressed.text: Nothing of this was pressed the week before, so there is no percentage to give. — Reports par note: new: pichhle hafte iska kuch QC pass nahi hua, isliye percent nahi. Yeh kis liye hai Batata hai ki zero se kuch hone ki chhalaang ko percentage mein nahi dikhaya ja sakta, taaki use girawat ya uchhaal na samjhein. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Week on week column mein new ka nishaan dikhta hai. Iska matlab hai ki us article type ka pichhle week kuch QC pass nahi hua tha. Hover karne par yeh note dikhta hai. Kab use karein Jab kisi article type par new dikhe aur jaanna ho ki percentage kyon nahi hai.

parts|fab|what happens if i press + Stor.text: + Store entry — button on Fabric Inventory: Opens the store entry form: opening stock, taken in, taken out or correction, for pieces or cloth. Needs the right to edit production entries. What it's for Opens the form for adding to or taking from the store's count by hand: the things the system cannot know by itself. How it works Shown only to people with the right "Correct production entries" (an admin always has it). Pick What this is , Pieces or cloth , the SKU or fabric and colour, How many and the date. Press Save entry ; the balance updates at once. When to use it At first setup, or when the shelf count differs from the screen.

parts|rep|Month किसलिए है.text: Month — Reports पर कॉलम: महीने के सारे हफ़्तों का जोड़।

parts|vreq|SKU lines ⤓ ka kya matlab hot.text: SKU lines ⤓ — Vendor Order Requests par button: Har request ki har SKU ki ek row download karta hai, request, vendor aur status ke saath; filter ke hisaab se. Yeh kis liye hai Kisi SKU ko requests mein dhoondhne ke liye line-star ka byora. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Har request ki har line ki ek row utarti hai. Column: Request, Raised, Raised by, Vendor, Work, Status, Vendor order, SKU, Item, Article, Subtype, Colour, Size, Qty, Unit, Came back, Balance, Wanted by, Vendor's date, Line.
