Manzoori ke baad Qty order ki matra hoti hai, kyunki approver ne badli ho sakti hai. Yeh filter maanta hai. Kab use karein Jab kisi vendor ya SKU ko line dar line jaanchna ho.

parts|so|what does Add the … missing sho.text: Add the … missing — button on Sales Orders: Admin only: some approved SKUs never reached the order book; this opens Review to approve again and add just those. What it's for If a write stopped halfway, some approved SKUs never reached production; this repairs it. How it works Shown to admins on an approved order where some SKUs are missing from the order book; the number is how many. Opens Review for that order, saying approving again only fills in missing lines. Press Approve into production ; SKUs already in the order book are skipped. When to use it When the list shows "N missing" in red for an approved order.

parts|qc|Spotting & touching button kya.text: Spotting & touching — Quality Control par option: Spotting (daag) ya touching (chhooti print) me bheje pieces dikhata hai jo abhi wapas nahi aaye; wapas lijiye ya reject kijiye. Yeh kis liye hai Theek karne bheje pieces ka hisaab rakhta hai, taaki QC table se jaane ke baad woh bhoole na jaayein. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Bheje har lot ki ek row, purana pehle, Spotting ya Touching ke nishan ke saath, sent, passed, rejected aur still there. Sankhya likhein aur Back — QC pass ya Reject dabaiye. Poori tarah nipte lot list se hat jaate hain. Kab use karein Jab spotting/touching kaam lautaye, ya baaki bahar maal ka peecha karna ho.

parts|article|ye Every marketplace is sh.text: Every marketplace is showing. Switch the picker back to “US marketplace only” to hide the — Article Review par note: Batata hai ki har marketplace dikh raha hai; baaki chhupane ke liye US marketplace only par wapas jaiye.

parts|palloc|what happens if i press Sea.text: Search design / group / printer — box on Printer Allocation: Type a design colour, group or printer name to narrow the list.

parts|repl|Hidden SKUs किसलिए है.text: Hidden SKUs — Replenishment पर बटन: टेबल में सिर्फ़ छिपाए गए SKU उनके असली स्टॉक और बिक्री के साथ दिखाता है; वापस जाने के लिए ← All SKUs दबाएँ। यह किस लिए है यह आपको छिपे SKU देखने देता है, जिनमें असली स्टॉक और बिक्री है। यह कैसे काम करता है Hidden SKUs दबाएँ: टेबल सिर्फ़ छिपे SKU सारे कॉलम के साथ दिखाती है। बटन ← All SKUs बन जाता है; लौटने के लिए दबाएँ। बाक़ी हर जगह वे अब भी हर गिनती और PO से बाहर रहते हैं। कब इस्तेमाल करें जब किसी छिपे SKU का स्टॉक देखना हो।

parts|fab|Guide · गाइड ka kya matlab hot.text: Guide · गाइड — Fabric Inventory पर बटन: नए tab में staff guide खोलता है: greige कैसे RFD बनकर cutting तक जाता है, English और Hindi में।

parts|flow|what does Printer show.text: Your question fits more than one answer. Which one do you mean? Printer · Production flow (box) Printer · Production flow (column) + Printer

parts|article|Cover (d) button kya karta.text: Cover (d) — Article Review par column: Maal kitne din chalega: (Total Stock + AWD + AWD in transit) ÷ roz ki bikri; 30 se kam ho to laal. Yeh kis liye hai Screen ka mukhya figure: SKU kitne din chalega, jisse priority aur cover buttons tay hote hain. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Yeh (Total Stock + AWD + AWD in transit) ko roz ki sale se bhaag dekar banta hai, Replenishment snapshot se. 30 din se kam ho to laal dikhta hai. Dash ka matlab cover ka figure nahi hai. Kab use karein Jab bhi dekhna ho ki SKU par kitni jaldi dhyan dena hai.

parts|prod|ye Filter SKU kis kaam ka hai.text: Filter SKU — In Production par box: Sirf un rows ke liye SKU ka kuch hissa likhiye.

parts|shop|what happens if i press Expre.text: Express / overnight — column on Shopify Orders: Business days by express / overnight service. What it's for Shows the fastest choice, express or overnight, for a parcel in the USA. How it works Same zone as ground; only the speed changes. When to use it When a customer is in a hurry.

parts|pack|Box … किसलिए है.text: आपका सवाल एक से ज़्यादा जवाबों से मिलता है। आप कौन-सा पूछ रहे हैं? Box क्या है Box … क्या है To क्या है

parts|pcut|All orders ka kya matlab hota.text: All orders — Cutting Data par option: Ek order ki cutting dikhata hai. Yeh kis liye hai Ek hi order ki saari cutting saamne laata hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai All orders se ek Order ID chuniye; table aur upar ke cards sirf usi order ke dikhte hain. List me wahi orders aate hain jo aapke dusre filter ke baad bachi entries me hon. Kab use karein Jab koi puchhe ki order ki kitni cutting ho chuki.

parts|fgi|what does optional show.text: optional — box on Finished Goods: Optional note on the entry.

parts|prod|All orders button kya karta h.text: All orders — In Production par option: Har order par ban rahe SKU dikhata hai; ek order chuniye to sirf uske SKU dikhenge.

parts|shop|ye Tracking kis kaam ka hai.text: Tracking — Shopify Orders par column: Parcel ka Shopify wala tracking number.

parts|fab|what happens if i press Any st.text: Any state — option on Fabric Inventory: Shows fabric in every state: greige, RFD and printed.

parts|ord|Fabric · colour किसलिए है.text: Fabric · colour — Order Console पर कॉलम: इस लाइन के कपड़े का फ़ैब्रिक और कलर। यह किस लिए है बताता है कि पंक्ति के आँकड़े किस कपड़े के हैं। कब इस्तेमाल करें ऑर्डर देने से पहले ऑर्डर विंडो में जाँचें।

parts|rep|Working days ka kya matlab hot.text: Working days — Reports par box: Is hafte ke kaam ke din (khaali ho to 6, zyada se zyada 7), roz ke figures ke liye. Yeh kis liye hai Factory asal mein kitne din chali, har week alag hota hai, aur per-day figures sahi dinon se hi theek bante hain. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Us week mein chale din likhiye; khali rahe to 6 liya jaata hai. Zyada se zyada 7. Box ke bahar click karte hi apne aap save hota hai, sirf usi week ke liye. Isse per-day figures bante hain, jaise People a day, average , aur thekedar ke per-person figures. Kab use karein Jis week chhutti ya extra kaam ka din raha ho, uske ant mein.

parts|flow|what does Open order show.text: Open order — button on Production flow: Opens the sales order of that line so you can correct it. What it's for Takes you straight to the sales order so the wrong SKU, quantity or detail can be corrected there. How it works Press Open order on the line. The sales order opens; fix the order or the master data. Come back and press Fixed — send to PPC . The button is shown only when that sales order is in the list of Sales Orders. When to use it As the first step of fixing a returned line.

parts|pbase|Approve button kya karta h.text: Approve — Job Work Register par button: Correction approve karta hai: entry theek waise badalti hai jaisa dikha hai. Apna khud approve nahi kar sakte; SKU ya date ka badlaav admin karega. Yeh kis liye hai Staff ko galtiyan theek karwane deta hai, bina kisi ke payment wale aankde chupchap badle. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Entry waisi hi badalti hai jaisi list mein dikhayi gayi, aur maang band ho jati hai. Aap apni maang manzoor nahi kar sakte, jab tak admin na hon. SKU ya tareekh badalne ke liye admin chahiye. Entry delete ho chuki ho, ya QC pehle hi naye received se zyada piece le chuka ho to rukti hai. Order ka baaki, saptahik report aur karigar ka bhugtan saath badalte hain. Kab use karein Jab maang sahi lage.

parts|vord|ye Send to a printer kis kaam.text: Send to a printer — Vendor Orders par button: Tick kiye SKU ko cut line banakar naya vendor order form kholta hai; wahan printer chuniye aur order place kijiye. Yeh kis liye hai Kami ko printer order me badal deta hai, SKU aur quantity dobara type kiye bina. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Vendor Orders screen ke Reserve ke andar; kam se kam ek SKU tick ho tabhi chalu hota hai. Naya vendor order form cut-pieces order ke roop me khulta hai, har tick kiye SKU ki ek line ke saath. Quantity Still to place wali sankhya hoti hai, poore pieces me upar ki taraf gol ki hui. Upar printer chunein, phir Place order dabayein (agar yeh request hai to form me Send for approval dikhta hai). Kab use karein Jab approved sales orders ko aise SKU chahiye jo abhi kisi printer ke paas nahi hain.

parts|flow|what happens if i press Over.text: Over 20 days — option on Production flow: Shows only orders placed more than 20 days ago.

parts|so|New dev किसलिए है.text: New dev — Sales Orders पर विकल्प: यह लाइन New development ऑर्डर है। यह किस लिए है बाकी order आम हो और सिर्फ़ एक line नया product हो, तो यह मुमकिन करता है। यह कैसे काम करता है उस line के Type drop-down में New dev चुनिए। Order Regular हो तब भी वह line New development के रूप में सेव होती है। Negative lines सिर्फ़ उसी type के orders में से घटाती हैं। कब इस्तेमाल करें आम order में नए product की line के लिए।

parts|shop|Product ka kya matlab hota ha.text: Product — Shopify Orders par column: Photo, naam, Shopify code aur jis Amazon code se jayega; dono code ek hon to Amazon box khaali chhodiye. Yeh kis liye hai Dikhata hai ki line kaun sa product hai aur Amazon FBA se bhejte time kaun sa Amazon code use hoga. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Picture, naam, variant aur Shopify code ek hi cell mein hote hain. Pack split nikla ho to Amazon code ka box green mein auto ke saath dikhta hai; apna code likhkar badal sakte hain. Jahan Shopify ne SKU nahi bheja, wahan SKU likhne ka box milta hai taaki FBA, India stock aur production line ko padh saken. Units per pack sirf tab dikhta hai jab pack split ho. Kab use karein Bhejne ya banane se pehle check karne ke liye ki line sahi product par hai.

parts|vord|what does Needed show.text: Needed — column on Vendor Orders: Pieces the approved sales orders ask for of this SKU. What it's for Shows the demand behind each SKU in reserve so printer orders can be sized right. How it works In Reserve on the Vendor Orders screen. The total pieces of that SKU across approved sales orders, every channel including Shopify (SHP-) orders, except orders that PPC plans itself. Only approved orders count. When to use it When deciding how many pieces to give a printer.

parts|shop|I have confirmed it — check a.text: I have confirmed it — check again : Email wala link kholne ke baad ise dabaiye; yeh dobara check karke aapko andar le jata hai. Yeh kis liye hai Confirm doosre tab mein hota hai, isliye ye page abhi nahi jaanta. Ye button use dobara jaanchne ko kehta hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Email ka link kholne ke baad ise dabaiye. App aapka account dobara padhta hai; address confirm mile to page reload hokar aapko andar le jaata hai. Nahi to Not confirmed yet likhkar pehle link kholne ko kehta hai. Kab use karein Email ka link kholte hi.

parts|rep|ye Export kis kaam ka hai.text: Export — Reports par button: Screen wali report CSV file mein download karta hai. Yeh kis liye hai Jo report saamne hai use spreadsheet mein le jaata hai, taaki bhej sakein ya us par kaam kar sakein. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Export dabaiye, aapke chune week, month aur brand ki CSV file download hoti hai. Har report ka apna layout hai; Production meeting · weekly apne saare hisse aur action points export karti hai. Kab use karein Jab report ko ERP ke bahar bhejna ya parakhna ho.

parts|so|what happens if i press Order d.text: Order date — box on Sales Orders: The order date; required, and part of the order number (CHANNEL-DDMMYYYY-NN). What it's for The date the order was raised on; it also forms part of the order number so two orders on different days never clash. How it works Required; defaults to today. The number is CHANNEL-DDMMYYYY-NN, shown as a chip beside the title. On a draft, changing the date or channel gives it a new number when you save. Once the order is placed the number stays fixed. When to use it When you raise an order, especially one dated a day other than today.

parts|repl|Both brands किसलिए है.text: Both brands — Replenishment पर विकल्प: Replenishment पर Ridhi और CPC दोनों दिखाता है। यह किस लिए है ब्रांड बॉक्स Replenishment को Ridhi, CPC या दोनों तक सीमित करता है। हर ब्रांड की अपनी स्टॉक सूची और संख्याएँ हैं। यह कैसे काम करता है Both brands , Ridhi या CPC चुनें; टेबल, गिनती और कुल बदल जाते हैं। दोनों होने पर Brand कॉलम दिखता है। Create PO from view एक ही ब्रांड का PO बनाता है: चुना हुआ, या दोनों दिखें तो Ridhi। कब इस्तेमाल करें नंबर पढ़ने या PO बनाने से पहले ब्रांड चुनें।

parts|pcut|… of … issued ka kya matlab h.text: … of … issued — Cutting Data par note: Partly issue: in pieces me se kitne karigaron ko gaye. Yeh kis liye hai Yeh batata hai ki ek entry ke kate piece mein se sirf kuch hi karigar ko gaye hain, aur kitne abhi baaki hain. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Issued? column mein Partly aur "N of M" ke saath dikhta hai. M kate piece mein se cut-reject ghatakar hai; N jitne jaari hue. Upar ke aankde Issued to karigars aur Still to issue jodte hain. Kab use karein Jab tay karna ho ki kitne kate piece dene baaki hain.

parts|fgi|what does Invoice # show.text: Invoice # — box on Finished Goods: Optional invoice number for this packing list. What it's for Puts the shipment's invoice number on the packing list so the paperwork matches. How it works Optional; type it before Start . It becomes part of the session title and is saved on the packing list. When to use it When the shipment already has an invoice.

parts|ord|All subtypes button kya karta.text: All subtypes — Order Console par option: Har subtype ki lines dikhata hai; ek subtype chunkar list chhoti kijiye.

parts|article|ye MOM kis kaam ka hai.text: MOM — Article Review par column: Aakhri meeting note, date aur likhne wale ke saath; + MOM ya + Note se naya judta hai — purana nahi mitta. Yeh kis liye hai Har SKU ki meeting ka silsila usi row mein rakhta hai jise aap dekh rahe hain. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Cell mein sabse naye note ki date aur likhne wala, note, aur "+n earlier" dikhta hai. + MOM (ya + Note ) dabakar saare notes wali window kholiye, likhiye aur + Add note dabaiye. Notes kabhi badle nahi jaate, aur galat note screen se hat'ta nahi; sudhaar ka naya note jodiye. Kab use karein Meeting mein, jab SKU par koi faisla ho.

parts|fab|what happens if i press + Grei.text: + Greige PO — button on Fabric Inventory: Opens a new greige purchase order to fill and save. Shows on the Greige POs view for people who can edit.

parts|pcut|Has this cutting gone to a ka.text: Has this cutting gone to a karigar? The order's issues fill its cutting oldest first. — Cutting Data पर जानकारी: कटिंग कारीगर को गई या नहीं, उससे filter करें; ऑर्डर के issue उसकी सबसे पुरानी कटिंग पहले खत्म करते हैं। यह किस लिए है कटिंग सीधे किसी कारीगर से जुड़ी नहीं होती, इसलिए यह फ़िल्टर दिखाता है कि कौन सी कटिंग इश्यू से पूरी हो चुकी है। यह कैसे काम करता है किसी ऑर्डर और SKU के Job Work Register में इश्यू पीस उस ऑर्डर की कटिंग से, सबसे पुरानी से, मिलाए जाते हैं। बॉक्स Used or not है जिसमें Unused , Partly used और Used हैं। यह सिर्फ पूरे रजिस्टर पर लगता है, इंतज़ार वाली सूची पर नहीं। कब इस्तेमाल करें जब सिर्फ वह कटिंग चाहिए जिसे अभी किसी ने नहीं लिया।

parts|vend|On order ka kya matlab hota h.text: On order — Vendor Portal par column: Is order ko kul kitna chahiye.

parts|flow|what does … orders` : 'Challa.text: … orders` : 'Challan'} — button on Production flow: Opens one challan for every line of this printed fabric and printer. What it's for Makes one challan for all lines that print the same fabric at the same printer, whichever order they belong to. How it works It is the last button in the By printed fabric (all orders) view. It says "One challan for n orders" when more than one order is in the row, otherwise "Challan". It opens the challan form with every line of that printed fabric and printer, ready to review and save. When to use it When the same print is waiting for many orders.

parts|ord|Opened 30+ days ago button kya.text: Opened 30+ days ago — Order Console par option: Sirf 30 ya zyada din pehle production mein khuli lines dikhata hai.

parts|ka|ye Custom dates kis kaam ka hai.text: Custom dates — Karigar Analysis par option: Karigar study mein hafton wale box Karigar Analysis Custom dates… apni dates ke liye From aur To box dikhata hai, zyada se zyada 93 din (Day by day mein mahine wale box mein apna hai). Yeh kis liye hai Aisi avadhi ke liye jo hafton ya poore mahine mein na baithe, jaise tyohar ka pakhwada. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai From aur To date ke box aate hain, jinme pehli baar is mahine ki 1 tareekh aur aaj bhare hote hain. Table un dates ki din-dar-din table ban jaati hai, zyada se zyada 93 din. Yeh Karigar study mein chalta hai; Day by day mein yeh mahine wale box mein hai. Kab use karein Jab saamanya hafta ya mahina sahi maap ka na ho.

parts|so|what happens if i press Sale mo.text: Sale month — box on Sales Orders: The month this order is meant to sell in, for example January 2027; optional. What it's for It tells the team which month's sales this order is meant for, so orders can be sorted by the month they answer. How it works Optional; pick a month such as January 2027. The list then shows "for Jan 2027" under the order date, and the Sale month filter finds it. When the order is approved, the month is copied onto its order-book lines. When to use it When the order is for a planned sales month.

parts|so|Deletion requests किसलिए है.text: Deletion requests — Sales Orders पर बटन: वे ऑर्डर लाइनें खोलता है जिन्हें प्रोडक्शन ने डिलीट करने को कहा है; ब्रैकेट का नंबर बताता है कितनी बाकी हैं। सिर्फ़ Sales Orders टीम के लिए। यह किस लिए है प्रोडक्शन ऑर्डर की लाइन खुद नहीं हटा सकता, इसलिए उसके अनुरोध यहाँ सेल्स टीम के फ़ैसले का इंतज़ार करते हैं। यह कैसे काम करता है यह सिर्फ़ Sales Orders टीम और admin को दिखता है; कोष्ठक की संख्या बताती है कितने अनुरोध इंतज़ार में हैं। यह सूची खोलता है: Order, SKU, Item, Ordered, Work booked, Why और किसने माँगा। लाइनें tick करके Delete ticked दबाएँ, या Note लिखकर Keep ticked । कब इस्तेमाल करें जब भी बटन पर संख्या दिखे।

parts|ord|Save quantities ka kya matlab.text: Save quantities — Order Console par button: Sirf admin: is card par likhi quantities save karta hai; deliver se kam nahi, aur badhat printer cap ke andar ho. Yeh kis liye hai Order card par bhare quantity sudhar ek saath save karta hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Badalne wali lines ke Ordered box mein nayi figure bharein, phir dabaiye. Jo pehle hi mil chuka usse kam figure mana hoti hai. Badhne wala printing order printer cap mein rahe, warna kuch save nahi hota. Vendor ko portal mein nayi figures dikhti hain. Kab use karein Jab printer alag quantity par sehmat ho.

parts|flow|what does Date show.text: Your question fits more than one answer. Which one do you mean? Date · Production flow (box) Date · Production flow (column) Date · Packing List

parts|fgi|Scan here button kya karta h.text: Scan here — Finished Goods par box: Har piece yahan scan kijiye; har scan khule box me ek piece ginta hai, galat article ruk jata hai. Yeh kis liye hai Yahin har piece box mein jane se pehle orders se milakar jaancha jata hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Keyboard-mode scanner se scan kijiye, ya code likhkar Enter dabaiye; cursor yahin rehta hai. Sahi: SKU ki line aur khule box mein +1, orders suchi ke kram mein bharte hain; hara rang aur beep. Jo SKU list ke kisi order mein nahi woh laal Wrong article dikhta hai aur judta nahi. Jo order bhar chuka ya jiska maal store mein nahi bacha woh amber dikhta hai aur judta nahi. Kab use karein Shipment pack karne ke poore samay.

parts|vend|ye How many of these you alre.text: How many of these you already have for THIS order. It comes off what is left to ask for on — Vendor Portal par note: Ab nahi dikhta: 15 Oct se printer ko kya diya aur kya wapas aaya, ye office darj karta hai (PPC · Production flow mein RFD challan). Printer har line ke neeche apna bheja maal (Vendor sent) ab bhi jod sakta hai.

parts|pmdb|what happens if i press Item.text: Your question fits more than one answer. Which one do you mean? Press count it in does not accept my count how to finish scan to pack

parts|hr|CC payout किसलिए है.text: CC payout — Finance & HR पर विकल्प: Company Contractor का भुगतान: वापस मिले पीस × रेट, हर व्यक्ति, आर्टिकल, सबटाइप और साइज़ के हिसाब से। यह किस लिए है Company Contractors का महीने का पे, उनके लौटाए पीस से बना हुआ। व्यक्ति-वार पे के हर सवाल के लिए यही view खोलें। यह कैसे काम करता है महीना और 1st – 15th , 16th – end या Full month चुनें; All employees में एक नाम चुनें तो सिर्फ़ उसी की लाइनें। कॉलम: Employee, Article, Subtype, Size, Pieces, Rate, Amount, नीचे कुल। लाइन पर क्लिक करके उसके पीछे की एंट्री देखें; Freeze पखवाड़े को बंद करता है। Full month में advance दर्ज होने पर advance paid और net payable भी दिखते हैं। कब इस्तेमाल करें हर पखवाड़े के अंत में और महीने के अंत में।

parts|shop|Where this order can ship fro.text: Main ye kar sakti hoon: koi bhi screen samjhana — poochiye "Finished Goods kya hai" koi kaam step by step karwana — poochiye "karigar ko kaam kaise de" site me dikkat ho to help — poochiye "screen slow hai"

parts|repl|what does Low show.text: Your question fits more than one answer. Which one do you mean? Low · Replenishment Low · Finished Goods when does status show low

parts|gdesk|Asked by button kya karta h.text: Asked by — Greige Desk par column: Receipt kisne aur kis din save ki. Yeh kis liye hai Receipt kisne save ki, taaki than galat lagein to pata ho kisse poochna hai. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Vyakti ka naam aur save ki date dikhti hai. Kab use karein Manzoor ya asweekar karne se pehle.

parts|pbase|ye All articles kis kaam ka.text: All articles — Job Work Register par option: Ek article type ki entries dikhata hai.

parts|ka|what happens if i press Set tar.text: Set targets — button on Karigar Analysis: Admin only: sets the ₹ labour value target a month per person, and any name's own target. What it's for Lets an admin set what each karigar is expected to make in a month. How it works Shown only to an admin, and only in Monthly target . The window has Per person, every month (₹) and an Own target ₹ box per name. A team is expected the per-person figure × its people, unless it has its own target. Save targets stores them for everyone. When to use it At the start of a month.

parts|vend|Sent to you किसलिए है.text: Sent to you — Vendor Portal पर कॉलम: Store ने इस ऑर्डर के लिए अब तक आपको कितना भेजा है।

parts|fab|No printer order was placed fo.text: No printer order was placed for that order, or less than was issued. — Fabric Inventory par note: Us order ke liye koi printer order nahi bana, ya printer ko issue se kam diya gaya.

parts|fba|what does From the Ready Goods.text: From the Ready Goods sheet — option on FBA Dispatch: Shows old dispatches brought in from the Ready Goods sheet; they went to Amazon long ago and are history, not work. What it's for Shows old history that came in from the Ready Goods sheet; there are no action buttons on these rows. When to use it Only to look up an old dispatch.

parts|so|From button kya karta h.text: From — Sales Orders par column: Badlaav se pehle ki quantity. Yeh kis liye hai Pehle aankda kya tha yeh dikhata hai, taaki hafton baad bhi badlav samjhaya ja sake. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Order window ke neeche "Quantities changed after approval" table me. Badlav maangte waqt order par us SKU ke jo pieces the. Sabse naya pehle; B2B orders ki "Details changed" table me bhi dikhta hai (size, colour, quality ya date ka pehle ka maan). Kab use karein Jab koi poochhe ki quantity pehle approve hui sankhya se alag kyun hai.

parts|gdesk|ye From kis kaam ka hai.text: From — Greige Desk par box: Is din ya uske baad ke PO aur challans dikhata hai. Yeh kis liye hai List ko shuruaati date se kaatta hai, taaki haal ke PO aur challan dikhein. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai PO uski banne ki date se, challan apni date se milta hai. Yeh To , status aur supplier ke saath milkar chalta hai. Clear ise baaki filters ke saath khali kar deta hai. Kab use karein Is mahine ya season ki delivery dekhte waqt.

parts|ord|what happens if i press Direct.text: Direction * — Horizontal Vertical — box on Order Console: Pick the print direction, Horizontal or Vertical; required for running cloth. What it's for Says which way the print runs on the cloth. How it works Pick Horizontal or Vertical. Required for each running-cloth line. Choosing a Fabric SKU fills it; the Use buttons from Fetch orders do not, so pick it yourself. When to use it Whenever you add a running-cloth line.

parts|ord|More cloth has gone out under.text: More cloth has gone out under this name than ever came in — is its opening stock entered u — Order Console पर जानकारी: लाल RFD in stock: इस नाम से जितना कपड़ा आया उससे ज़्यादा गया — देखें ओपनिंग स्टॉक किसी दूसरी स्पेलिंग में तो नहीं। यह किस लिए है कपड़े का शेल्फ़ स्टॉक आए में से गए को घटाकर गिना जाता है। लाल आँकड़ा बताता है कि जितना आया उससे ज़्यादा गया, यानी गिनती शायद गलत है। यह कैसे काम करता है लाल आँकड़े पर माउस ले जाकर नोट पढ़ें। ओपनिंग स्टॉक में वही कपड़ा किसी और स्पेलिंग में दर्ज हुआ है या नहीं देखें। स्टॉक रिकॉर्ड में स्पेलिंग या ओपनिंग एंट्री ठीक करें। कब इस्तेमाल करें लाल RFD in stock दिखे तो Short by पर भरोसा करने से पहले स्टॉक रिकॉर्ड जाँचें।

parts|prod|Both brands ka kya matlab hot.text: Both brands — In Production par option: In Production par Ridhi aur CPC dono dikhata hai.

parts|rep|what does Add show.text: This is on Dashboard , not on this screen. Show — button on Dashboard: Reads and shows the change history or the recycle bin for the month picked. What it's for The history is not read when you sign in; it is read only when you ask. Show asks. How it works With Who changed what , reads the newest 300 changes of the chosen month. With Recycle bin (deleted records) , reads the newest 300 deleted records. The search box then narrows the lines already read. Non-admins get "Only an admin can read the change history." When to use it After picking the view and month, and whenever you want the latest entries.

parts|shop|Arrived now button kya karta.text: Arrived now — Shopify Orders par column: Abhi kitne pieces aaye likhiye; pehle se taiyar sankhya bhari hoti hai. Phir Accept dabaiye.

parts|gdesk|ye This is the whole lot bac.text: This is the whole lot back (close it) — Greige Desk par box: Jab lot ka aakhri maal ho tab tick kijiye: shrinkage nikalta hai aur 5% se zyada par approval chahiye. Aadha lauta ho to khaali chhodiye. Yeh kis liye hai Desk ko batata hai ki processor is lot se farigh ho gaya, taaki nuksan ka hisaab nikal sake. Yeh kaise kaam karta hai Default tick: na laute metres shrinkage gine jaate hain. 5% tak receipt seedhe stock mein jati hai. 5% se upar yeh anumati wale vyakti ka intezaar karti hai. Aanshik wapsi ke liye khaali chhodein; shrinkage baad mein niklega. Kab use karein Har Receive RFD par, yeh batane ke liye ki yeh lot ki aakhri delivery hai ya nahi.
